tei:div.tei:p: ༄8 zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhi khro ngan song dongs sprugs kyi: sngon 'gro thar ba'i rta mchog zhes bya ba bzhugs so:rasko na mo gu ru pad+ma ka ra ye: sgo〉ma/lhadzoza kye ma: khams gsum rig drug mtha' yas sems can rnams: bde chen dag pa'i lam la da snyogs cig: thog med dus nas da la ma thug bar: khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnas nas sdug bsngal myong: da ni bla ma dkon mchog gsum la gtod: dal brgyad 'byor bcu tshang ba'i mi lus 'di:da ras lan cig thob pa don ldan mdzod: phyi nas rted dka' u dam wa ra 'dra: tshe la nges pa med pa'i rmi lam bzhin ljon shing kha nas 'dabs chags 'tshogs pa 'dra:'khor ba'i bya ba zad mtha' yod ma myong: dmyal khams bco brgyad rgyu ma'i 'khrul snang des sdug bsngal las la zad pa'i mtha' ma thug: rgyu 'bras bag byas don dang ldan par mdzod: 'chi ba snying nas dran par bla ma mkhyen: 'khor ba'i gling nas thar ba'i don chen du bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi: mkha' khyab pha ma'i lus blangs

sems can rnams:go 'phang sangs rgyas thob par sems bskyed do:nyon mongs gnas stongaspyi bor pad zla'i steng:bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' bzhugs par gsal sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab spyi bor bab:dam tshig nyams chags nad gdon sdig sgrib byang:sor byang sngags kyi bslab pa gang nyams pa:thams cad ye dag rang lus sgrib pa byang:rdor sems thugs las hūṃ yig dkar po las gsang sngags yi ge brgya ba'i 'khor lo 'khor:rlung chen sgra dbyangs sangs rgyas gsang sngags sgra: grags stong 'pho 'gyur med pa'i chos sgra sgrogs: ma badz+ra sa twas ma ya sogasanyams chags sdig sgrib thams cad sarba pā paṃ dha ha na shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā skyesa.ā hūṃ/phyi nang sgod bcudagasang ba'i rgyan bkod pa gling bzhi ri rab nyi ma zla ba dang:lha ma'i longs spyod dpal yon bkra shis brgyad:yid bzhin nor bdun bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad rtsi bcud sman 'bras gser ri rol mtsho bdun blo yis blang te kun tu bzang po sogs:zhi khro rgyal ba'i tshogs la maṇ+ḍal 'bul:'gro kun thar ba'i lam la drangs du gsol ma.uḥtī/

ra rdo: bka' brgyud chu bo yab sras ston 'khor dang rgyal ba dgongs rgyud rigs 'dzin brda rgyud dang:gang zag snyan rgyud 31ga ser tshig gi brgyud bstan pa'i mnga' bdag kun bzang rig lnga sogs:slob dpon pad+ma garma gling pa dang:rje 'bangs bka' 'khor khye'u chung lo tsa dang:dbab bskur lung ston man ngag bla ma dang:rdo rje slob dpon drug gi ston pa la:sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i gsol ba 'debs:byang chub lam la bar chad med pa dang:'khor ba dongs nas sprug par byin gyis rlobs:bla ma yab yum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing:rang gi sgo gsum thim nas sgrib pa dag:chos long sprul sku'i dbang gis bdag rgyud grol:bla ma yab yum gnyis ga'i lte ba nas:hrī yig dmar la 'od zer dang bcas pa:rang gi lte bar thim nas dbang bzhi myong:slar yang bla ma yab yum 'od du zhi:rang gi snying gar thim nas sgrib bzhi dag:dbang bzhi mnyam bzhag rig pa gcer bur mthong:rigs stong sang cha nam mkha' mtha' bral nas:bar do drug gi snang sems 'phyang thag chad:lta ba'i gdeng mthong bsgom pa'i bog

thon nas: spyod pa blang dor bral nas rang sems mthong khyab brdal de bzhin nyid du ngar bso'i nas rig pa 'od gsal g.yo 'gul kha gting bral: snang stong ka dag ngang la mnyam par bzhag dpal ldan rtsa ba'i sogs skye ba kun tu sogs dpal ldan bla ma khyed sku sogs de ga: nus ldan rdo rje'i bris pa dge'o maṅga lo/

ra/: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las: zhi khro ngan song dongs sprugs kyi: gsol 'debs kun gzhi rang grol bzhugs so:༄〈: kun bzang zha khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo spra ca/lhadzo dbyings rig zung lardug 'od gsal ngang rnam rtog ldan pa'i ma gos par e ma ho dmigs med zang thal chos sku rdo rje 'chang: gtan med rgya yan longs sku rig lnga dang 'dzin med 'od gsal dga' rab rdo rje la: byar med blo 'das ngang nas gsol ba 'debs: gshis lugs ma bcos bṛ seng ha dang: yin lugs ma bslab dz+nyā na su dra che: snang lugs ma 'gags bi ma mi tra la gnas lugs rang ngo rig pa'i gsol ba 'debs: ye grol rang zhal pad+ma 'byung gnas dang: rang grol 'gags med ye shes mtsho rgyal yum: cer grol zang thal dkon mchog 'byung gnas la: shar grol rang ngo rig pa'i gsol chos kun ye dag kun bzang zhi khro'i lhaḥ rtogs tshogs gzhir dag mkha' 'gro dam can sprin: kun gzhi gshis dag rtsa rgyud bla ma la: gzung 'dzin rnam dag ngang skye gnas bar do rig pa rang sar

grol: bsam gtan bar do rig pa rang grol rtogs: 'od gsal kha sbyor 'char bar byin gyis rlobs 'chi kha bar do thim rim rang sar grol: chos nyid bar do 'od gsal ma bu 'dres srid pa bar do rlung sems thad grol te: nang dbyings bum skur sad par byin gyis rlobs de ltar gsol ba 'debs pa'i mi bzang pha las kyi 'brel ba kun nyam chags rtogs sgrib yong sa byang te kun bzang sa la the tshom med rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag lha mgon po'i bsrung nga sprul thug sras dpal du shog gu h+ya brda tham snyi/ zhes pa'ang klong gsal nam mkha'i rnam 'byor rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rjes rgya rong brag lha mgon po' gnas mdun sang brag g.yu'i ral gsang nas bton pa yi ge'i 'du byed nye gnas mkhar lo' bgyis pa sarba maṅga lo

58: zab chalo 'di gsal snyalnga thagi las nazhashe sa nganag sange sangabasgrugs kyi: skyabs sames chegos bsags thugs rje'i nya' pa bzhugs sor1: kun bzang zhe salha la phyag 'tshal lo 68ba 7) skyabs yul gsal gdab skyabs sems tshogs bsags ni skyabs yul mdun 'gyalanam mkhar seng khrir pad zla nyi ma'i khar:bla ma kun bzang yab yum la bka' brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kyis bskor ba yi dam che mchog yab yum la rgyud sde dang bsgrub sde'i dkyil 'khor rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i bskor ba mkha' 'gro rdo rje rnam 'byor ma la gnas yul dur khrod he ru ga'i dpa' bo dang rnam 'byor ma'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa: mchog gsum skyabs gnas rgya mtsho'i sprin rab 'byams la rdo rje chos skyongs ba'i srung ma bka' sdod pho nya rgya mtsho phrin las rab 'byams kyi char rgyun spros bzhin bzhugs pa la: thams cad kyi thugs mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i gter chen po'i: rang cag gdul dpyabs med yongs la spyan gyi gzigs zhal gyi phyogs dgyes 'dzum brtse ba'i rnam 'gyur du ma'i mdangs dang ldan pa la bdag

cag yid khyed shes kyi dad pa drag po sgo gsum ling gis bkal nas skyabs su 'gro bar mos la: na mo dgongs brda snyan brgyud bka' drin gsum ldan rjes: rtsa rgyud bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi: bde gshegs kye 'jigs bka' dgongs phur gsum sogs: yi dam lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi: rdo rje rnal 'byer phag khros seng gdong sogs ye shes mkha' 'gro tshogs la lus gnas rtsa rlung thig ler rang chas pa'i: zhi khro rab 'byams dal la ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje ye rdzogs sang lta bsgom spyod pa'i gshis la skyabs su mchi gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu rang chas pa'i: kun bzang khyab brdal klong la skyabs su mchi: lan gsum sems bskyed ni lha tha snyad snang cha bdag bzhan yul gsum chos: gnyis med gnyis su bzung ba 'khrul ba'i blo: thams cad mnyam nyid sangs rgyas rang chas zhal: ji bzhin klong gyur byang chub sems mchog bskyed:lan gsum tshogs bsags na skyid ātshu ka dag zang thal chos sku'i maṇ+ḍal sprin: rang bzhin 'od gsal nges pa lnga ldan dpal: rtogs tshogs rang grol rig pa ye shes gsang:

58: sku gsum dgongs don rtogs phyir 'bul gyi bzhes: yo anywa maṇ+ḍal byu dza spra ra ṇa sa ma ya a hūṃḥ dza hūṃ be ho tshogs zhing rnams rang la thim pas gnyis su med par bsam mo dkar gtor 'bul ba na 〉ཿlas rin po che'i sgod du oṃ las gtor skyems zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur oṃ āḥhūṃ: 3 a ka ro'i sngags lan gsum gyis spel hūṃ hrī nga ni rgyal ba kun dngos thod phreng rtsal: lha klu dri za grul bum mi 'am ci: stong gsum dregs pa'i tshogs rnams dam la 'dus: rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pa'i bka' la nyon: rgyal bstan rin chen sgron me srung shing spel: gdul zhing 'jig rten bde skyid chos kyi skyongs: nad mug mtshon gabrugs rgud pa mtha' dag sol kla slo gdug pa'i ngan sngags log sbyor bzlog: sde gnyis bstan spel bshad sgrub bstan gzhi skyongs: thugs mthun khrims gtsang rgyal ba'i thugs bzhed bzhin: phan bde'i phrin las 'byung ba'i grogs mdzod cig: rnal 'byor gnyer bcol bka' las ma 'da' zhig skyid 'o ka pā la sa pā ri wa ra e dam bha listo khā kha hi bgegs gtor gtong ba ni ts+tshaḥ las

rin po che'i sgod du oṃ las gtor ma bdud rtsir gyur o ā ༷shāX shā nyon cig bgegs dang log 'dren 'byung po'i tshogs: tshe rabs sngon gyi lan chags 'jal ba'i phyir dbang chen khro bo rol ba'i bka' la nyon: ting 'dzin sgyu mar rol ba'i 'phrul nor longs: dengs bzung byang chub snying po ma thob par: bgegs dang log par ma byed phyir dengs shig: skye ṭa ki ra dza: nyu dza sarba bhisnye bha lirnya kha kha khā hi khā hi kyi mtho ba nam mkha' yangs pa bar snang dngaḥ dma' ba sa gzhi sa steng rgyu ba rnams: mchod spyin gtor ma'i tshim nas rgyud dza la teḥ thar lam byang chub sgrub pa'i lam la gzholaḥ sarba bhu ta rā dza sa ma yaX de nas bka' bsgo bgegs tshogs bskrad srung gur phub sogs gzhung ltar 'jug sbyor dpa sa rjes gsum tshangs ba yi bsnyen bsgrub 'bras bu tshe 'dar rted rig 'dzan sa la the ma tshom rdo ri sems dpa'i sras su 'gyur sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag la mgon posasrung thugs kyi srasad 'phrad gyur cig gu rgya brda tham lha zhes pa'ang nye gnas ma ra lo' thugs 'dun mi bzlog tsam du rig 'dzin 'a 'a lu rdo rje' seng brag g.yu ya ral gsang nas btan pa'i bdo ras las bsgyur ba'i yi ge pa ni zhi mas brgyas pa dge legs 'aze laḥsarba maṅga la/

rasko: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhi khro ngan song dongs sprugs kyi: las byang 'khor 'das rang grol bzhugs so:ra rdo: kun bzang sgokhro'i lha la phyag 'tshal loḥ pho rnam2) ma bcosarig pa stong gsal 'di dus gsum rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor che so ma rang bzhag nga bskyangs nas bskyed rdzogs kun gyi gsang srog 'phrog sa ma ya dben pa'i gnas su dam rgya bcad sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshangs bar bslabs dang po'i las la rnams pa lnga bskyed rdzogs lta dgongs ldan pa' 'jug sa ma mā dang po lta ba'i 'tshams gcod na hūṃ dmigs med chos sku'i ngang nyid lasaḥ nga bdag mtshan mar 'khrul ba'i gdon: zhen med rang grol glud gtor 'dis tshim par gyis la dgongs pas bsgrad: / hūṃ us ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa bsrung gur phub pa ni /: stong nyid snying rje'i ngang can lasaḥ mi shig byang chub sems kyi guraḥ ye shes 'od kyi ra gur 'khrigasaḥ 'byung po rgyu ba'i skal ba medaX oṃ badz+ra byudru d+marma tsakra dz+wa la ram̐ rakru rakru hūṃ phaṭa: gsum pa mchod pa'i yan lag brgya na oṃ āḥhūṃḥ nam mkha'i mthar thug zhing khams rab 'byams na: bde gshegs rgya mtsho zhi khro yongs

rdzogs lha mi mngon dbyings nas ye shes gzigs pa'i dgongs gnas 'dir 'gro ba'i don phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ thabs shes pad zla rin chen nyi ma'i gdan: bdud bzhi dregs pa spyi 'chang bsgol ba'i khar zhi khro rab 'byams brtan par bzhugs su gsolaḥ gnyis med gus pa'i yid kyis phyag bgyi'o: lus dang lenangs (1da dge bsags mchod pa 'bulaḥ stong gsum rab 'byams bkod mdzes maṇ+ḍal stobs sgo gsum nyes sgrib gnong 'gyod bshags sbyang sdomaḥ rnam dkar dge spyad kun la rje yi rangaḥ gdul byar zab rgyas chos 'khor bskor du gsol rgyal ba sras bcas mya ngan 'da' med bzhugs dus gsum dge bsags mkha' khyab 'gro la bsngo: thams cad bla med theg pa'i snod gyur nas: zhi khro rab 'byams go 'phang myur thob shog bzhi pa mchod sa byin bams na sno dmigs bsam brjod bral ngang nyid las brtan g.yo 'dod yon chos so cogaḥthams cad rig pa ye shes brgyanaḥ kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin du gyuraḥ lnga pa sman gtor rak+ta byin rlabs ni skyi ātshwaḥm hā sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta hūṃ trīX 'iḥ bla ātshu ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal

ra rdo: / trī 'i skyirngo āḥshāX ma hā bha lidha hūṃ hrī4ཿ sa badz+ra (1 dhu pe a lo ke gharnye nai wi t+ya shabha aḥ/ de dag sngon 'gro'i rim pa'oḥs ma māḥganyis pa rnamasagrangs bco lnga las dang po ting 'dzan rnam gsum ni (ཿ rnam par mi rtog de bzhin nyidaḥ ma 'gags rang gsal kun tu snang: rtsol bral rgyu yi yi ge ā skye 'chi bar do sbyongs phyir shar: 3 ā hūṃ badz+ra sa ma dhi ā gnyas pa gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni hūṃ rang byung yum lnga'i mkha' klong duḥ bhan+ta rkam rlon nid pa yis: rtsigs pa thod mkhar gru bzhi brjid rngam pa'i khro chen gzer gyis gdabaḥ 'khor ba gnas stong rak+ta sbyaraḥ rab 'jigs bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs dur khrod brgyad kyi tshangs khang 'khrigasaḥ zhing chen bla bre ༄ dra'i togaḥ nyi zla'i sang skar mi 'jigs sgo gza' klu dreg pa'i ka gdung gral: seng 'brug chu srin rma bya'i zhalaḥ mig 'bras tsit+ta ba su ti'i drwa ba drwa phyed mdo 'dzin bkra: zur bzhi 31ga bzhi rta bab ldanaḥr khrag khyims 'ja' 'od 'khyags byon song gtso brgyad kyis btegs khri pad rna nyi ma ru tra dang zhi dang khro gdan ma 'dres shar ngo mtshar yid 'phrog lta na sdag:

dkyil 'khor 'degs pa'i gzhi ru grubaḥ e badz+ra maṇ+ḍal la r+ghaṃḥ tir+ya ka rat+na sti ra bamaḥ 2 pad+ma sti ra baṃ a tsan+t+ra ste ra baṃ: ma sur+ya sti ra baṃḥ du tra kro ti sti ra baṃ: sa ma ya a la la ho gsum pa lha bskyed ni hūṃ bdag nyid tha mal gnyug sems 'di: skad cig dran rdzogs kun tu bzang chos nyid bzang mo 'khril sbyor rol rgyan bral bcer bu 'od phung 'bar: 'ja' zer thig len zlum 'khyil klongaX snang cha dkar la shes rab mthingaX gsal dag rang bzhin med par bsgomaḥ / dkyil 'khor phyogs bzhi dbus dang lngar seng glang rta mchog rma bya dang: shang shang pad zla nyi ma'i khar: rnam shes rnam dag rdo rje sems: nam mkha' dbyings phyug 'khril sbyor rol: rdo rje dril 'dzin longs sku'i brgyan rang snang dkyil 'khor dbus phyogs su: snang la rang bzhin med par gsal: shā gzugasaphung rnam dag rnam snang mdzad: 'khor lo dril 'dzin longs spyod rdzogs: chu khams rnam dag ma ku rol: g.yas su sa snying myu gu dkar: g.yon du byams pa kla shing dkar mdun du pubye me tog dkar rgyab tu la se me long dkar bde gshegs rig kyi gtso

ra rdo 'khor drug: ma yeng rang gsal 'dzin med bsgoms: ka tshor phung rnam dag rin 'byung ser: rin chen dril 'dzin bcu gsum brgyan sa khams rnam dag spyan ma 'khril: g.yas su kun bzang snye ma ser: g.yon du nam snying ut+pal ser mdun tu dhu pe sbos phor ser rgyab du ma le phreng 'dzin seng: rin chen rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yeng gsal stong 'dzin med bsgom: ka 'du shes rnam dag snang mtha' dmar: pad+ma dril 'dzin bcu gsum brgyan: me khams rnam dag gos dkar 'khril g.yaja su 'jam dpal ral gri dmar: g.yon du spyan gzigs pad+ma dmar mdun du a lo mar me dmar: rgyab tu girti yi waṃ dmar: pad+ma rigs kyi gtso 'khor drug: ma yengs ting 'dzin rol mtshor gsal: (ཿ 'du byed rnam dag don 'grub ljang: ral gri dril 'dzin longs spyod rdzogs: rlung khams rnam dag sgrol ma rol: g.yas su sgrib ser po ti ljang:g.yon du phyag rdor ral gri ljang: mdun du garje dung zhal ljang rgyab tu nini zhal zas lngang: las kyi rigs gyis gtso 'khor drag: gsal la 'dzin med chen por bsgom: zhe

ba'i lha tshogs de rnams kyang: mnyen lhug 'khrul ldems tshul dgu'i 'byud: longs spyod rdzogs sku'i chas rnams rdzogs: stong gsal rang bzhin med par bsgom: /༷ steng du brgya byin yi waṃ dkar: shar ltor theg bzang go mtshon ljang: lho nub shāka thub bsregs lhung ser: nub byang seng ge po ti mthing byang shar kha 'bar sgrom bu dmar: 'og tu chos rgyal me chu nag: 'gro don rdzogs mdzad sprul sku'i tshul: pad rkyang steng na bzhengs stabs rol stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin bsgom: kaka kakaka 'khor 'khor lo'i rtsubs dbus su: phyol song gtso brgyad kyis btegs khar: rin chen pad zla nyi ma'i khar: bdud bzhi spyi chings bsgol ba'i steng: bdag nyid che mchog he ru ga: smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa g.yas dkar g.yon dmar gar dgu'i 'khyud: rdo rje kha ṭaṃ rnge'u chung g.yas dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhag g.yon: kro ti shwa ri 'khril sbyor rol dur khrod chas rdzogs 'dor thabs bzhugs mdun du byud+ma he ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgad: g.yas dkar g.yon smag dbus mthing nag: 'khor lo dgra sta

ra da ral gri g.yas dril bu thong gshol bhan+ta g.yon: bhurnya kro ti gnyis med 'khril: dur khrod chas rdzogs me sang 'gying: (ཿ shar rtsubs badz+ra he ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing nag rdo rje bhan+ta dgra sta g.yas dril bu bhan dmar thong bshol g.yon: badz+ra kro ti 'khril sbyor rol: dur khrod dpa' chas gar nyams rdzogs: (ཿ lho ru rat+na he ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas sngo g.yon dmar dbus ser nag: rin chen kha ṭaṃ be con g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rtse gsum g.yon: rat+na kro ti mnyam par sbyor: rab 'jigs me rlung 'tshubs dbus 'gying (ཿ nub rtsub pad+ma he ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad g.yas ser g.yon ljang dbus dmar nag: pad+ma kha ṭaṃ dbyug do g.yas: dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung g.yon: pad+ma kro ti gnyis med rol dur khrod chas rdzogs me klong 'gying: shāḥ byang rtsubs garma he ru ga: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad: g.yas dkar g.yon sngo dbus ljang nag rgya gram ral gri kha ṭaṃ g.yas: dril

bu bhan dmar thong gshol g.yon: karma kro ti gnyis med rol: kun kyang dur khrod chas rdzogs shing: gar dgu'i nyams 'byud me dpung klong: byol song gtso bo rin chen brag:pad+ma nyi steng gsal bar bsgom: (ཿ gnas ma chen mo mched brgyad ni: shar phyogs ko'u ri zhing dbyug dkar: lho phyogs tso'u ri dma' 'geng ser nub phyogs pra mo chu srin dmar: byang phyogs be+e ta bhan dmar ljang: shar lho puṣ+ka rgyu 'dren ser: lho nub garma bhan gri smug: nub byang tsan+ta baṃ 'dren skya: byang shar sme sha ro za mthing zhing chen gdan la gar gyis rol: ma yangs ting 'dzin rol mtshor gsal ( yul ma chen mo mched brgyad ni: sidha seng gdong ro za spug: kri ta bya rgod rgyu 'dren seng kaṅka dur bya zhing phrag khur: kha kha bya rog bhan gri nag: hu lu 'ug gdong lcags kyu mthing: zhing g.yang mgo 'phrang gzigs shams klubs: me dud rlung sprin 'tshubs ma'i klong zhing chen gdan la gar gyi rol: ma yengs ting 'dzin rol mtshor gsal: hūṃḥ shar du rta gdong lcags kyu dkar: lho ru phag gdong zhags pa ser nub tu seng gdong lcags sgogs dmar:

ratāX: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang tshad med rang mdangs sgo skyongs bzhi zhing rkyang gdan la gsal bar bskyed: dī rnal 'byer sgrub paci steng gcig ma las bzhi'i phrin las spel mdzad pa'i: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni: shar du zhi ba'i las mdzad drug: srin mo g.yag gdong rdo rje smug: tshangs pa sbrul gdong pad+ma ser lha chen gzigs gdong tri shul ljang: gtogs 'dod sre gdong 'khor lo sngo: gzhon nu dred gdong mdung thung dmar: brgya byin dom mgo rgyu zhags dkar: zhing rkyang gdan la gar gyis rol: rnal 'byor drod nyul tshogs khangs 'grims nyu lho ru rgyas pa'ilas mdzad drug: rdo rje pha waṃ spu gri ser: zhi ba chu srin bum pa dmar: bdud rtsir sdig gdong pad+ma dmar: zla ba khra mgo rdo rje dkar: be can wa gdong dbyug do ljang srin mo stag gdong thod khrag nag: zhing rkyang gdan la gar gyis rol rnal 'byor drod nyul bde stong bsted nub tu dbang gilas mdzad drug: za ba bya rgod be con sngag: dga' ba rta gdong khog chen dmar stobs chen khyung gdong dbyug do sngoḥ srin mo khyi gdong rdo rje dmar:

'dod pa pu shud mda' 'geng ser:nor srung sha mgo bum pa ljang: zhing rkyang gdan la gar gyis rol: bsgrub pa'i drod skyong bde stong spel:/ byang du drag po'i las mdzad drug rlung lha spyang gdong ba dan ljang mi mo skyin gdong gsal shing dmaraḥ phag mo phag gdong mched zhags nag:rdo rje kha gdong zhing chung sngo sna chen ljang nag gling chen baṃ chu lha sbrul gdong ljang ser sbrulaḥzhing rkyang gdan la gar gyis rolaX gsang sngags la dgyes dga' bzhi bskyed:(ཿdkyil 'khor phyi rims sgo bzhi ༄tsho shar du khu phyug lcags kyu dkar lho ru ra gdong zhags pa seraḥnub tu seng gdong lcags sgrogs dmar: byang du sbrul gdong dril bu ljang tshad med rang mdangs sgo skyongs bzhi zhing rkyang gdan la gar gyis rol:gtso gsar gnas yul dbang phyug ma:ngo bo rang rtsal sgyu 'phrul garaX ma yengs ting 'dzin rol mtshor dra/ snang la rang bzhin 'dzin med bsgom: bzhi pa spyan 'dren ni hūṃḥ dpe med bsam brjod bral ba'i dbyangs nyid las: mi g.yo lhun rdzogs kun bzang yab yum dang: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs rnamasaḥ sku gsung

ra : thugs yon phrin las 'gags med par: 'gro don gzung 'dzin dag pa'i mos ngo rtsa skal ldan byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol: mchog thun dngos grub char rgyun ltar du dbob: nyon mongs 'brul rtogs ka nas dag pa dang: nyams rtogs yar ngo zla ltar 'phel gyur cig: lnga pa b.las gsol ni sno snang la rang bzhin ma grub sgyu ma ltaraḥ 'od zer ye shes lnga ldan gzhal med khangaḥ rin chen khri rkang pad nyi bdud bsnol khar dam pa rig brgya'i lha tshogs bzhugs su gsol: drug pa phyag 'tshal ni (ཿ yid chos rnam dag kun bzang yab yum dang tshogs yul rang grol sems dpa' sems ma'i dal rtogs tshogs ka dag zhi khro rab 'byams la gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis phyag 'tshal loX bdun pa phyi mchod ni sno skyemed ka dag kun bzang yab yum dang: 'gags med zang thal zhi khro rab 'byams la: dag pa rnam gsum ye shes mchod pa'i sprin me tog bdug spos dri zhal rol mo'i rigasaḥ dbyings las sprul te ye shes dbyings su 'bul: thugs rje 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol brgyad pa nang mgo ni sno

gzod nas rnam dag zhi khro rab 'byams la: kun snang ma 'gags shes rab rol ba'i rgyan: snod bcud 'dod yon gzugs sgra dri ro reg ༷ rdo rje chos ma'i tshogs su rab sprul te gnyis med mnyam pa chen po'i 'bul lag na: thugs rje brtse bar dgongs te bzhes su gsolaḥ 'gro ba'i tshogs rdzogs sgrib gnyis dag gyur cig dgu pa gsang mchod na sno dbyangs rig gnyis med kun bzang yab yum dang: sgyu 'phrul zhi khro rgyal ba rgya mtsho la: snang stong gsal stong bde stong grags stong dang: tshor stong myang stong reg stong dran stong cha: yid rig ye shes phyag rgya bde ba'i gzugs: zag med kun snyoms ye shes don rtags ldanaḥ bde ba ro snyoms rlung sems dag par 'bulaX sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rgyas gyur cigaḥ bcu pa sman mchod ni hūṃ hrī: rig lnga yab yum mnyam par spyor ba las: dug lnga phung lnga rnam par dag byed cing sku lnga ye shes mngon du gyur byed sman: zhi khro dam pa rig brgya'i tshogs la 'bul: sarba pañtsa a dṛ ta kha ram̐ kha hi bcu gcig pa rak+ta 'bul ba ni ṭ+wāṃ tri: khams gsum rnam dag bhasmo'i snod nang duḥ nyon mongs gzung

ra rdo: 'dzin chags pa bsgral ba'i khrag: zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i tshogs la 'bul 'khor ba ka nas dag phyir bzhes su gsol: ma hā rak+ta kha ram̐ kha hi: babyu gnyis pa garter ma 'bul ba ni hūṃ hrī: phyi snod 'jig rten rab 'byams gzhong pa rtsa nang bcud sems can dpa la 'byor gtor chen bshams nyi zla gza' skar 'dod lnga'i lha mo'i brgyan: zhi khro rab 'byams dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul: 3 ma hā bha lirnyi kha tī brgya gsum bstod pa bya ba na hūṃ mi 'gyur zang thal ka dag chos kyis sku: brjod 'das 'gags med rang byung ye shes gsung: mi g.yo smra bsam brjod pa bral ba'i thugs: kun bzang yab yum gnyis med klong la bstod: / chos sku kun khyab nam mkha' lta bu la longs sku gsal dag nyi zer ci bzhin 'phro: sprul sku gang 'dul chu zla'i 'gro don mdzad: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs la bstod: (ཿ stong gsum lhun sdug gzi brjid 'od zer 'bar: 'khril bag mnyen lhugs gzhon tshul ldan pa'i sku: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan rnams lhun grub pa'i: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i sku la bstod: rtswaX snying rje'i

rngams dang zhi tshul ldan pa'i thugs rgod dang gshe dang drag shul che ba'i gsung: dpa' brjid sgegs tshul 'jigs su rung ba'i sku: gar dgu'i nyams 'byud khrag 'thung tshogs la bstod: sno sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi bos gtsug bkur srung: dgos 'dod char 'bebs gdul bya'i re ba skong: dam tshig stong srog phyag gi mthil du gnas bka' sdod rdo rje'i gsang srog 'chang la bstod: bcu bzhi pa bzod gsol ba ni (ཿ bla ma kun bzang mi g.yo chos kyi sku: bde chen gsal dag 'gags med longs spyod rdzogs: ris med shar grol sna tshogs sprul pa'i sku rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dgongs su gsol: ma rig mal dub bdag sogs 'gro ba yis: thog med nas bsags da lta yan chad du: rtsa ba sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig la: rig dang ma rig 'khrul ba'i las dbang gis dam drigs nyams chags 'gal 'das nongs pa kun: mi 'chab mi rbed gnong 'gyod sems kyis bshags: klong yang chen po'i ngang du bzod par bzhes tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: badz+ra sa ma ya ā: bco lnga pa 'dzab bskul na (ཿ 'og min

rathurdo: dur khrod gsang chen dkyil 'khor nas rig stong bla ma kun bzang yab yum dang: gdung rag ma 'gags zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: 'bar ba'i gar mdzad khrag 'thung khro bo'i dal: dag pa rig 'dzin 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i dbyings: rdo rje'i sgog ldan dam can sde bdun bcas: mi mngon dbyings nas dgongs pa'i 'dzab rgyun bskul:zhi ba tshul dgu khrag 'thung gar nyams bcas: gzung 'dzin mtshan ma'i 'khor ba gnas stong phyir: bskyed rim srog sdom gzer bzhi'i tshangs ldan pa'i gsal dag sku yi snang shes dri ma bcom: 'gags med rdo rje'i sgra mtshan rang sar grol: ting 'dzin dgongs pa'i nyon shes dri ma sbyangs: lha sngags chos nyid 'khor lor yongs rdzogs sad: ma 'grub bar du 'dzab rgyun ma gtong ngo: sne badz+ra cit+ta ā badz+ra sa min+ta bha dra sa / badz+ra dh+rika hūṃ da du shwa ri s+t+waṃ: dzi na dzika: le te shwa ra ti s+t+waṃ: swā rat+na trika: ma mo ha ra ti s+t+waṃ:e a ro lika: paṃ ra ka ra ti sto: hā pra dz+nyā dhika dam badz+ra ra ti s+t+waṃ k+ṣ-i hi ra tsa ya swā hā: me tri dha ra ni swā hā: nyu swā ra tsa ya swā hā: dre a gasnye ya swā hā hriḥha hūṃ pad+ma bha ta ma swā hā:

rlu dṛ a ram̐ gha ya swā hā: snyi sa re pa ya swā hā: dzhai ku ru pa ṇi hrī swā hā: ka wā su sa ma ya t+t+waṃ: hūṃ pubye a be+e sha ya s+t+waṃ: tre ma le sa ma ya s+t+waṃ dza dhu pe pra be sha ya s+t+waṃ:hrī ghirti ra ga ya ho: be di baṃ su gi ni sto:ho gharnye tsit+ta ho: a nirta ra ga ya mi s+t+waṃ: tho mu ne kro swā hā: tshe mu rne pro swā hā: ma mu ge hūṃ swā hā: ka mu ne k+ṣe swā hā oṃ mu ne+e rgyu swā hā: tshe mu ne ye swā hā o badz+ra kro ta bi dza ya / ka badz+ra aṅga sha dza: rgo badz+ra kro ta ya man+ta ka 4༷ badz+ra pa sha :: tso badz+ra pad+ma ta kṛ ta h+ya snyi wa hūṃ: badz+ra sbo ṭa rba: tshe badz+ra kro ta a dṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li (ཿ oṃ badz+ra ghadhe ho: zhes zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyis mtshan sngags 'di thos pa tsams kyis kyang na rag chen por mi gtong ngo: ma ma hā kro ta ma hā bṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa ma ha kro ti shā ri sto: tshe badz+ra kro ta ma ha gri he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: badz+ra kro ti shwa ri sto: tshe budha kro ta ma ha sri he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: bud+dha kro ti shwa ri s+t+waṃ: tshe rat+na kro ta ma hā dṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: rat+na kro ti shā ri snye: tshe pad+ma kro ta ma ha dṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa: pad+ma kro ti shwa ri ste: cha garma kro ta ma ha dṛ he ru ka hūṃ phaṭa karma kro ti shwa ri ste: o badz+ra ko'u ri ha badz+ra tso'u ri ha: badz+ra pra mo ha

ra rdo: badz+ra be+e ta li ha: badz+ra puk+ka si haX badz+ra gasma ri haḥ badz+ra tsasto li ha badz+ra sma sha ni ha: sa badz+ra ser+ha mu kha he badz+ra bya kṛ mu kha he: badz+ra sri la mu kha he: badz+ra shwa na mu kha he: badz+ra kri ta mu kha he: badz+ra shaṅka mu kha he badz+ra shā na mu kha he: badz+ra kri ta mu kha he: badz+ra shaṅka mu kha he: badz+ra kha kha mu kha he: badz+ra hu sdo/ mu kha heḥ snyen badz+ra aṅga sha dza: skyong badz+ra pa sha hūṃ oṃ badz+ra spo ṭa baṃ oṃ badz+ra gaṇ+ḍi ho: tho ma nu rak+ṣa su bh+yo: pra ma ni bh+yo: re'u tri ma bh+yo: bha na bh+ya bh+yo: ko ri ma bh+yo: in+d+ra ya nu bh+yo: sedha ka la ni bh+yo: a dṛ ta bh+yo: so'u ne bh+yo ta ma haṃ bh+yo: rakru si bh+yo bak+ka si bh+yo: ra tri ma bh+yo: re tri re ma ti bh+yo: e ka tsa ra ma bh+yo: ma nu ha ra ma bh+yo: si ti ka ma bh+yo: bha ya bh+ya bh+yo: ma hā ma ra ṇa bh+yo: eka na ye bh+yo: ba ra hrī bh+yo: tsa mun+d+ra bh+yo: bu ta na bh+yo: pa ni badz+ra bh+yo: ma hā ka la bh+yo: tsa ka la badz+ra bh+yo: badz+ra lasto dha ra na bh+yo zhes khrag 'thu khro bo' spyi sngags 'di bzlas pas sgra thos pas ngan song gyi skye sgo kheg shing skye ba bdun tshun chad sangs rgyas par 'gyur ba mi bslu ba'i tha tshig yin no gzhan yang spyi drilasngags dang shams kyas bsgyur zhi khro rigs lnga'i yi ge brgya lag chad kha bsko sa 'dzab mchod bstod daro sa grub zhu ba rnams bya'o de

dag dngosagazhi'i rim pa'o sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya gsum pa sakyis rim pa las las kyi rim pa bcu bdun las dang po tshogs kyis bgegs bsal ba ni (ཿ nyon cig ma ga par 'dren pa'i gdon bgegs rnams gsang chen tshogs la blta bar mi dbang ba: rang bzhin mi gnas de bzhin nyid du bsgrad: chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du lhun gyis grub: sarbasnga tsu ta ya phaṭa: gnyis pa byin rlabs ni (ཿ bdag nyid rdor sems lha yi thugs ka nas: sa dkar āḥdamar hūṃ mthing gsal ba las: 'od zer kha tog lnga ldan spros pa las: zhal zas tshogs mchod ye shes bdud rtsir gyur oṃ ā hūṃ hrī ha ho gsum pa spyan 'dren pa ni (ཿ 'og min chos dbyings stong gsal pho brang nas: bka' rgyud bla ma zhi khro rab 'byams lha gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can sde bdun bcas: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnal 'byor nyams chags skong la rtogs pa spor: mchog thun dngos grub char ltar dbab tu gsol 31 badz+ra sa ma yā dza dza bzhi pa tshogs phud 'bul ba ni hūṃḥ bla ma kun bzang mtha' bral chos kyis sku: nyag gcig gsal dag zhi khro rab 'byams lha chos smongs skrung ma

ra : nor lha gter bdag la: zhal zas tshogs kyis mchod 'bul bzhes su gsol ma ma hā ga ṇa tsakra kha hi lnga pa bshags pa ni ho: bdag cag ma rig sems gzhir 'thas pa las: rtsa ba yan lags dam tshigs chags nyams kun: mi 'chab mi zed ye shes tshogs bcas bshags: dam skong slong yang chen po'i bzod par bzhes: sa ma yā ā: drug pa tshogs bsgral ni hūṃ bh+yo: chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos bzhin gzugs sku 'jigs rngam khro bo'i phyag rgyar bzheng: ma rtogs log 'khrul gnyis snang ru tra kun: chos nyid mnyam pa chen po'i dbyings su bsgral: sarba du tra mā ra ya phaṭa: bdun pa bstabs pa ni (ཿ ye zog dang po'i sangs rgyas kun tu bzang: sgyu 'phrul rol pa zhi khro rab 'byams lha: chos srung nor lha gter bdag bka' sdod bcas: gzung 'dzin bsgral ba'i bam ston mchod pas bskangs: sarba cha ༅ me sa rak+ta tsit+ta la kha hi: brgyad pa tshogs la rol ba na ho: 'dir tshogs rnal 'byor pho mo mched dang lcam: zhi khro rab 'byams dgyes pa'i bzhes lhag ni: tshogs mchod dag pa bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin can: sku gsung thugs

kyi dngos grub a la la: ma hā su kha sirnyi pha la tswa: dgu pa lhag ma ni (ཿ dang po gtsang la phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams phud la dgyes bar du gnyis med tshogs la mi rol rgyu: rnal 'byor ye nas lha dang gnyis med gcig: tha ma tshogs kyi lhag ma'i mi rngams rgyu: dbang phyug ma sring gang lang dam la gnas: de nas rnam gsum gcig tu mi bsre rgyu: dam ye ro snyam rdo rje'i srog ldan phyir: tshogs kyis lhag ma kha chu'i mi bran rgyu rnal 'byor ma srang gsang srog gcig pa'i phyir: bh+yo: chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyong dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad: dkar ser dmar ljang mgo brnyan cir yang bsgyur gnas yul dur khrod 'grim shing tshogs khang nyul: mi lpags gos gyon bhan+ta khrag skyogs thog: dam tshig srung shing mkha' la rgyu ba yis bstan pa'i dgra sgrogs sngon gyis g.yar dam can: lhag gtor bzhes la phrin las gang bcol bsgrub ma ma rdzas ṭa bha lirnyi kha hi: bcu pa bskul ba na (ཿ bka' gsang 'dus pa dam tshig dkyil 'khor 'dir: zhi khro rab 'byams 'brin las gnyer 'dzin pa:

ra rdo: mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyongs rgya mtsho'i tshogasaḥ la las bstan skyongs la las bka' bzhin sgrub: la las chos mdzad la las gtsug lag srungs: la las dben gnas la la rnal 'byor grogs: la la stong khyabs la las sgrub drod nyul: la las dgra sgrol la la mnyam bzhag gnas: la la bram ze la la srin po'i rigs la la than dang ltas ngan cho 'phrul bdag: kun kyang zhi khro'i rnam rol ma nges gzugs: sprul pa yang sprul las mdzad bye ba 'bum: rig rtsal dregs pa pho mo ma ning kun: chos nyid rol ba'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rten 'brel nyes tshogs ka nas dag pa dang: gzung 'dzin chos skur sang ba'i phrin las mdzod: bcu gcig pa bka' yi chad mdo bgo ba ni hūṃ bh+yo:sngon tshe 'dus dus bskal pa'i dang po la: bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru ga'i: ma rtogs log 'khrul ru tra bsgral ba'i tshe: ko'u seng dbang phyug dregs pa'i sde dpon dang: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis: gsang sngags dam blang dbyar dam mnos pa ltar: 'dod yon brgyan pa'i mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bka'

bshin sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig bh+yo de 'og dus tshigs bar gyis gnas rnams su: bka' babs rig 'dzin skyes chen thams cad kyis: zhabs pad gtsug bkur dbyar dam mnos pa bzhin bka' sdod dregs pa dam can pho mo'i tshogs: zhen 'dzin rang grol gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags bshad sgrub bsgom pa'i grogs mdzod cig bh+yo da lta dus ngan lnga yis snyigs ma 'dir: nyon mongs 'chol rnyogs spyod pa'i smag rum las: rang byung kun bzang dgongs nyams skyong ba yis: skal ba bzang po'i las 'phro mdzom pa las: bdud bgegs dam sri'i nyes 'tshe mi g.yo bar: klong rdol rang byung ye shes sgom pa'i grogs: chos skyongs dregs pa dam can rgya mtsho yis: gtor ma 'di bzhes 'khrul snang rang grol nas: kun gzhi chos skur sangs ba'i phrin las mdzod bcu gnyis pa bstan skyongs brngan pa ni bh+yo: dkyil 'khor mtha' skyongs dbang phyug nyer brgyad kyis: rnal 'byor rig pa'i rgyan shar gtor ma longs: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs: rnal 'byor bde stong ting 'dzin dregs tshad spel bh+yo: bod khams

ra/: skyongs mdzad brtan ma bcu gnyis po: rang rang g.yog 'khor sprul pa sman dang bcas rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis 'dir byon gtor ma longs: gangs ldongs bod skyongs bde skyid ldan par mdzod: rnal 'byor rkyen bzlog nyams rtogs yon tan bskyed tshe chos nor spel grub 'bras mchis par mdzod: 'byu gsum rta bro brdung ba ni sa phyogs med phyogs dang bral ba'i phyogs dbyings nas: nyon mongs dug lnga 'joms pa'i ye shes dro: snang stong bde gsal rig pa'i mkha' 'gro rnams: bde gshegs kun 'dus mnyam nyid bro brdung bas: rlung sems mtshan 'dzin dgra gdud ar la gtad: bro yang snang stong ye shes lnga yis bro glu yang grags stong ye shes lnga yis glu: gar yang rig stong ye shes lnga yi gar: ye shes lnga yi bro glu gar bsgyur bas: ma rig nyon mongs ka dag dbyings su nan khyed āpa/ཿswā hā: s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: bcu bzhi pa bzod gsol bya ba ni med snang 'khrul blo gti mug bdag dbang gis: ye nas dag chen chos sku'i rang bzhin la: tha snyad spros rtog cho ga lhag chad nongs 1nga yangs chen po'i ngang du bzod par bzhes:

sa ma ya ā: lag chad kha bskong yag brgya bzla ā: kun gzhi ye dag tshos sku'i klong yang su: rang rigs gsal dag gdod ma'i sangs rgyas zhal: dbyer med ma bcos bde chen zhi khre'i dal: bskang dang bshags par bya ba'i yul las 'das: 'di don rtogs na ma byung ma skyes pa'i bcing grol las 'das gnas lugs btsan sa zin: bco lnga pa bkra shis bya ba ni o stong zhing bdag med chos sku'i bkra shis shog: āḥ gsal la 'dzin med longs sku'i bkra shis shog: shāḥ thugs rje 'gags med sprul sku'i bkra shis shog: rang ngo shes pa gzhi yis bkra shis shog: blo bral rtog pa lam gyi bkra shis shog: gzung 'dzin rgya grol 'bras bu'i bkra shis shog: 'khor ba dongs sprug mdzad phrin bkra shig shog:bcu drug pa bsngo ba smon lam ni na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rab dkar dge ba 'dis: khams gsum 'khor ba dong nas sprugs gyur cig: sku gsum 'bras bu rang sa zin pa dang: rnam gsum phrin las rgyun chad med par (sgog bcu bdun pa bsdu ldang ni ā: gzugs snang ma 'gags sgyu 'phrul zhi khre'i dal: rim bsdus 'ja' tshon mkha' la yal ba

ras/: ltar: snang stong gnyis med yul bsam las 'das bzhag sgra grags brjod 'das sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gsung: rtsol bsgrub mi dmigs 'brug sgra yal ba ltar:grags stong brjod 'das chos dbyings ngang la bzhag: sems kyi 'gyu ba rang rig 'dus ma byas: shar grol klong thim mkha' la sprin deng ltar: skye 'gags 'gyur med ka dag thugs 1nga bzhag: a a.ā: skad cig stong zhing bdag med ngang nyid las: rig stong gzung 'jug rdo rje sems dpa' yis: snang grags dran rig sgyu ma lta bu rtsa gang 'dul 'gro ba 'dren pa'i spyod lam bya'o: de dag rjes kyi ram pa'o sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya de ltar sgyu 'phrul zha khro yas bskyed rdzogs 'khor 'das rang grol 'di 'brel tshad rig 'dzin zhang du bkod na rag skye sgo kheg par nges gcesargya cog bzhag skal ldan da4 'phrad nasa'akhor ba dong sprug shog gu rgya brda thim bka' 'di brag lha mgon po'i bsrungs thugasasrasarig 'dzin dpal tu sprod sgod min gnasasu zag ma byed skal bzang pad tshal smin byed shog zhesapa'ang nye gnasamakhar lo'i nan tan kyis bskur ngor kho bo nam mkha'i rnal 'byorareg 'dzin 'ja' lu rdo rje'i sang brag g.yu yi ral gsang nas brton pa' brda' ragasu bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shisapar gyur cag
ras : zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhi khro ngan song dong sprugs kyi dbang chen 'gro drug rang grol thugs rje'i lcags kyu bzhugs so:

ra rdo: kun bzang shi lnga'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo rtagacanacho rdzo ston pa masdod ldan chu bo rdzogs gnyer ldan las la mkhas pa yis bdag mdun bum bzlas tshogs bsags bya rig pa'i me tog dor byas nas bdag nyad 'jug pa'i chos changs rjes dad dam gtsang ma'i slob ma rnams sgrub khang phya rol sgo dru 'tshogs lus ngag yad sgrib khrus kyis sbyangs bar chad bgegs la chang glud bsngo drag sngags khro gar me chu' thun spros la gegs sel bsru 'khor bsgoms bla ma tshogs da mchod pa 'i bstod lus ga yid da gus phyag bcas gsol ba 'di ltar gdab par bya yinam mdza na pa thugs rje can: bdag sogs rig drug sdug bsngal las: thar ba'i lam la 'god byas phyir: ye shes lcags kyu'i bzung du gsol: lan gsum gdab slob dpon gyisa'agrod tshangs kyi chos 'byung dang theg pa chen po' chos rnams bshad rgyu 'bra kya khrid ram pa ra brtan nas blo chos kyi lam la bskul chags nyams sbya sa phyar yig brgya grangs mangs su bzla bde gshegs zhi khro'i 'dzab kyi bzlas dmigs rgya cher sgrogs de nas dal du 'jug phyir gsol ba gdab pa na yinam mgon po thugs rje can: bdag sogs las ldan pho mo rnams: thar ba'i lam du 'jug 'dod pas: bde chen rdo rje'i lam bstan 'tshal lan gsum gdab slob dpon gyis om

༄8: 'dir tshogs skal bzang pho mo rnams sngon chad nyon mongs 'khrul ba'i basmus: dug lnga'i dbang gi 'khor bar mnar: deng 'dir rgyal ba'i thugs rje'i zin 'gro mgon bla ma'i thar lam bstan: don 'bras 'byung phyir dad gus bcas: sku gsum dkyil 'khor 'dir shog cig bla med snying po bdag gis sbyin de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni mdun gyisanam mkhar bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang zha khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogasamangon sum du bzhugs pa ra gsal btab la e ma dredags bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'a11 dgongs rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang: zhi ba chags bral dam pa'i chos: tshogs mchog phyir mi ldog pa la bdag ni gus pa'i skyabs su mchi: lan gsum ho: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang dam pa rig brgya'i dkyil 'khor la: deng bzung bla med byang chub bar: gus pa'i skyabs su nye bar mchi lan gsum bya sems bskyed pa ni ho mkha' mnyams 'gro ba ma lus pa ma bsgral bsgral dang ma grol grol: dbyug 'byung mya ngan 'das la 'god: smon pa'i byang chub sems ni bskyed: lan gsum ho sngon gyi

rgyal ba thams cad kyang: sdom pa la ni gnas pa ltar: bdag kyang bla med 'jug pa'i sems: phar phyin drug slob sdom gsum bzung: kun don tshul khrims gsum la bslabs: 'gro ba'i don la brtson par bya: lan gsum sdom bzungs ni ho kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang: rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: rdo rje rigs kyi dam tshig tu:rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya dang byang chub sems ni mi spang ngo: rin chen rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sbyin pa rnams bzhi rtag tu spyin: pad+ma rigs kyis dam tshig tu: theg pa gsum dang chos rnams spyad: las kyi rigs kyi dam tshig tu: sdom pa thams cad ldan par bya: de bzhin rigs kyis dam tshig tu dkyil 'khor gsum dang 'bral mi bya: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig kun: ma sdo/sa bdag gis 31ngas ba/ bzung mag dar bkab ci me tog spyon slob ma lha gsal ye shes dbab de nyad brtan par bzhugs su gsol slar yang mag dar dbye ba ni rten: ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis: 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar de bzhin khyod kyi spyan dbye bas: rgyu drug dri ma bral gyur cig: na ra ga: pre ta ga: tidu ga: ha wa la he wa a

ra rdo: ro/ tsashākya pra we ro/ ya phaṭa: de nas sku bum pa' dab gi chu rgyun gyis rgyu drug gi bag chags sbyangs nas rigs drug gnas nas drangs la rigs 'dzin gyi gral la spyod phyar maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni e ma kun mkhyen 'gro mgon dgongs srid pa'i mal dub 'gro ba rnams: bla med rig 'dzin sar bsgrod phyir: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol: lan gsum bla ma'i lan gnang ba kye ho tshe rabs sngon nas las 'phro can: khyed cag rig 'dzin sar spyod cing: nyon mongs rgyu lnga gnas stong phyir: bdud rtsi bum pa'i dbang bskur bya: dkyil lasar dbus kyi sman lnga'i bum pa thog la 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dkyil 'khor dbus kyi bum pa 'di ni: sman lnga'i gtam cing sangs rgyas rdo rje rigs kyi gzi byin phab pa yin pas khyod la dbang bskur bas zhe sdang dmyal ba'i gnas nas thar de thugs rdo rje rigs kyi dbang thob pa yin pas: spro ba bskyed cig: shāḥ chos dbyings rnam dag bum pa rtsa rdo rje rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: dmyal ba'i skye sgo kheg par 31ga me chu lag tu gtad la (ཿ tsha grangs sdug bsngal skyobs pa'i phyir me chu

bsil drod ldan pa 'dis: skal ldan rnams la dbang bskur bas: na rag sdug bsngal bral bar re ga: du:da ha da na sarba na ra ka de he hūṃ phaṭa: ( badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs rdor sems yig brgya bzla hūṃ a bhi ༷༷/ a: de ltar sman lnga'i bum pa dang me chu'i dbang bskur ba'i: nyon mongs pa zhe sdang gi kun nas bslang ba'i sdig sgrib las kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas: na rag dmyal bar skye ba'i sgo bcad: ma rig rmongs shing dub pa'i gcong nad las grol thugs rdo rje rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur:'gro ba 'dren pa'i mthu phun sum 'tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur cig: gong ltar gsol btab lan gnang byed kyang rung ngo dkyil 'khor nub kyi dra lnga'i bum pa thogs la 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dkyil 'khor nub kyi bum pa 'di ni: bdud rtsi dri lnga'i gtam pa la sangs rgyas gsung pad+ma rigs kyis gzi byin phab pa yin pas khyod la dbang bskur bas 'dod chags yi dwags kyi gnas nas thar te gsungs pad+ma rigs kyis dbang thob pa yin pas dad pa dang mos gus bskyed cig: shāX bde ba chen po'i bum pa na pad+ma rigs kyi lha

ra rdo: tshogs bzhugs skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: yi dwags skye sgo kheg par shog: rin chen sgrom bu lag tu thog la ā: rin chen mjes pa'i sgrom bu dza mi bzad gter gyi bcud dang ldan: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: pre ta'i sdug bsngal bral bar 37ga: pre: pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka te he dun hūṃ phaṭa: e pad+ma sa twa sa ma sogs snang mtha'i yag brgya bzla ye pad+ma a bhe ṣiñtsa a: de ltar dri lnga'i bum pa dang rin po che'i sgrom bus dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs pa 'dod chags kyi kun nas bslang ba'i sdig sgrib las kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas: pre ta yi dwags su skye ba'i sgo bcad: a 'thas nyon mongs pa nyes tshogs las grol: gsung pad+ma rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur: 'khrul snang 'gro ba 'dren pa'i ded dpon du gyur cig: gsol btab lan gan gong ltar dkyil 'bor shar gya 'bru lnga'i bum pa thog la 'o skal ldan rig kyi bu rnams dkyil 'khor shar kyi bum pa 'di ni: bcud 'bru lnga'i yongs su gtam pa la sangs rgyas sku bde gshegs rigs kyi gzi byin phab pa yin pas: khyod la dbang bskur

bas gti mug dung 'gro'i gnas nas thar te sku bde gshegs rig kyi dbang thob pa'i mos gus tshad med pa bskyed cig: / mi shig 'gyur med bum pa rtsa bde gshegs rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: dud 'gro'i skye sgo kheg par shog: po ti lag tu gtad la o mkhyen gnyis rab 'bar po ti 'di: rgyal ba zhi khro'i gsung gsang rtags: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: tidu ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: su ma tha ma tha sarba tidu ka ga te he tun hūṃ phaṭa: mabud+dhā sa twa sa ma ya rnam snang yig brgya bzla oṃ brnya a dhi ṣiñtsa a de ltar 'bru lnga'i bum pa dang shes rab rig pa'i po ti'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug gi kun nas bslang ba'i sdig sgrib las kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas: tidu ka dud 'gro'i gnas su skye ba'i sgo bcad: chags zhen nyon mongs pa lnga'i nyes pa las grol: sku bde gshegs rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur las nyon zug ngu'i gzir bas 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ded dpon du gyur cig gsol bawa lan gnang gong ltar dkyil 'khor byang gi

rathurdo: snying po lnga'i bum pa thogs la 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dkyil 'khor byang gi bum pa 'di ni phun tshogs snying po lngas rnam par gtam pa la sangs rgyas phrin las garma rigs kyis gzi byin bskyed pa yin pas: khyod la dbang bskur bas phrag tog lha ma yin gyi gnas nas thar te phrin las las rab rigs kyi dbang thob pa yin pas nges shes rgya chen po dang ldan par mdzod cig: ྅ phrin las lhun rdzogs bum pa dra garma rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha min skye sgo kheg par shog go mo lag tu gam la sngo nyon mongs bdud kyi g.yul ngo las: rnam par skyobs byed go mtshon 'dis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: he sa ka yi sdug bsngal bral bar shog: tri sarba du la sarba garma pra we sha ya phaṭa: 1 darma sa twa sa ma ya don 'grub yig brgya bzla ha gan a bhi ṣiñtsa ā deltar snying po lnga'i bum pa dang bdud kyi mtshon srung go chas dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs pa phrag tog gi kun nas bslang bas sdig sgrib las kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas: phrag tog lha ma

yin gyi gnas su skye ba'i sgo bcad: gdos bcas phung po lnga'i nyes pa las grol: brin las garma rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur: a 'thas nyon mongs pa phrag tog gi las las skyes pas 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed nus par gyur cig: gsol btab lan gnang gong ltar la dkyil 'khor lho'i rin chen lnga'i bum pa thogs la 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dkyil gcor lha'i bum pa 'di ni: 'dzad med rin chen lnga'i mdzes par gtam shing bkang ba las yon tan rin chen rigs kyis dbang phyin phab pa yin pas khyod la dbang bskur bas nga rgyal lha'i gnas nas thar de yon tan rin chen rigs kyi dbang thob pa la mos gus tshad med pa dang ldan par mdzod cig: ྅ yon tan lhun rdzogs bum pa dzasgyu rin chen rigs kyi lha tshogs bzhugs: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas: lha yi skye sgo kheg par 31ga: pa waṃ lag tu gtad la sāX g.yeng ba'i phyogs lhung 'joms byed cing: bdud kyi rgol bzlog pi waṃ 'dis: skal ldan khyod la dbang bskur bas lha yi srid las grol bar shog: ā sarba ta tha ga ta bi dan khaṅga tshin+ta tshin+ta hūṃ phaṭa: sā rat+na

ra : sa twa sa ma rin wāng yig brgya bzla sā:rat+na a bhe ṣiñtsa ā de ltar rin chen bum pa dang g.yeng ba'i rgol 'joms yi waṃ gi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs pa nga rgyal gyi kun nas bslangs ba'i sdig sgrib las kyi sa bon bag chags dang bcas pa byang zhing dag nas: zag bcas dge 'bras lha'i gnas su skye ba'i sgo bcad mngon rlom 'dod yon lnga'i nyes pa las grol: yon tan rin chen rigs kyi zhing khams la dbang bsgyur ma rig las nyon gyi mnar ba'i 'gro ba rnams 'dren pa'i ded dpon byed nus par shākyar cig kun la bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa re brjod me tog 'thor de nas gzul snang mi yi gnas las bsgral zhing nyam chags bskang phyir spros bcas bum dab sbyin pa la maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol btabs ni che/ ste/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dgongs: bdag ni dal 'byor rten thob kyang: sdom gsum dang 'gal ma rig pas: dam tshig nyams chags dpag med bsags: kun mkhyen thugs rje'i gter chen gyis: nyams chags skong la dab mchog rtsol: zhes lan gsum gdab da khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyis lha tshogs rnams

dpang du btsug:pad dkar gdan gnas sems dpa'i sgom bzlas 'bog par gyas la yag ge brgya pa ta ra ri sgogasal bshags sbyang gyasashig de nasathun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga las mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang ni (ཿma rig nyon mongs zhe sdang me:rnam shes phung po'i dri ma kun:dag byed lha yi bdud rtsi yis:mi bskyod pa ru dbang bskur ro:sa badz+ra.a dhar shu dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa :rin lung dbu ma gyi dbang ni sa nga rgyal ri bobarnyil byed cing:tshogs phung rnam par dag bya'i phyir bde gshegs srid thob dbu brgyan 'dis:rin 'byung nyid du dbang bskur ro:su rat+na sa man+tadz+nyā na rat+na saṃ bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa :snang mtha' rdo rje'i dbang ni sno'adod chags dug rnams na 'joms shing:mtshan 'dzin 'du shes grol byas phyir:mi phyed gsang ba rdo rje 'dis:snang ba mtha' yas nyid dbang bskur:e pad+ma pra dz+nyā a bhi ṣiñtsa me:don 'byub rdo rja'i dbang ni 〉phrag tog lcags sgrogs bkrol byed cing las rlung 'du byed rmang bshigs phyir:'gro don mthar phyin dril bu 'dis:don yod grub par dbang bskur ro:ha ri sha a nu te dzā na pa te badz+ra garma a snyi ṣiñtsa :rnam snang ming gi dbang ni hūṃḥm rig

ra〈: gti mug mun sel zhing: gzugs phung dri ma dag byed pas: rdo rje'i ming gi dbugs dbyung phyir: rnam par snang mdzad mnga' gsol lo: 6 ) tsakra ma du a mi dz+nya na badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa : ngo sprad ni 'o skal ldan rnams la thun mongs rig pa'i dbang lnga bskul bas: nyon mongs pa dug lnga'i dri ma sbyangs: phung po lnga'i bag chags bkrus: sku lnga dang ye shes lnga'i don rgyud la bzhag: zhing khams lngar mngon par byang chub pa'i mnga' gsol: rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa 'dus ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig:bum dbang dngos zhu phyar maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni kye ho: kun mkhyen ye shes rgyal ba dngos: rdo rje slob dpon rtse ba'i dgongs: tshogs smon las 'dzoms skal ldan la: bum pa'i dbang mchog bskur du gsol: lan gsum gdab rjes bum pa spyi bor bkod bdud rtsi ngag tu blud phyag mtshan rnams lag g.yas su gtad srog shing dang rin po che'i lhung bzed lag g.yon du gtad 'o rig kyi bu rnams rin po che'i bum pa 'di nyid spyi bor bzhag pa'i dus su: rdza 'am shing gi rnam par ma sems par: lhun grub rang byung gi gzhal med khang sgo gru rta bab mtshan

nyid bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i rang bzhin can gyi 'od klong: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs bkra dpung nge 'od thibs se byon nas khyed rang rnams kyis spyi bo nas zhugs tshe lus kyi sgrib pa dag: sku yi dbang mchog thob: dam tshig nyams chags skong shing: snang stong dag pa rab 'byams su shar ba la mos gus bskyed cig: (ཿ rin chen bum pa 'od lnga'i 1nga rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams rdzogs: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas lha dbang thob pa'i snod ldan gyur: snebadz+ra a bhi ḍiñtsa a: ma brnya swā rat+na e pad+ma hākarma sogs ā: :ཿ srog shing rin chenabar bu ni: thugs rtag zhi khro'i lha rnams mtshon: skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas skye med rtogs pa'i dbang thob shog oṃ tshin+ta sarba a wa ra ṇa hūṃ phaṭa: (ཿ rigs kyi bu rnams lhun rdzogs shing: 'khor lo lnga la dbang bsgyur phyir: phyag mtshan rnams lnga'i dbang bskur bas: 'khor ba dong sprugs dbang thob shog: ka badz+ra bud+dha rat+na pa d+ma garma a snyi ṣiñtsa tre ro sprod gdab pa na de ltar sgo gsum smin par byed pa dang sregs shing lhung bzed phyag rgya rnams lnga'i dbang bskur bas

ra : yon tan dang byin rlabs bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan te:sman lngas dbang bskur ba'i nyon mongs pa'i bcong nad las grol:tshad med snying rje chen po rgyud la skye:shar phyogs mngon par dga' ba'i zhing khams mthong:a 'thas zhe sdang gi rtog bsgrib dag:sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal mjal:thugs rdo rje rigs kyi sa lam yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no:'bru lnga'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs dug lnga'i nyes pa las grol tshad med btang snyom chen po rgyud la skye:dbus phyogs stug po bkod pa'i zhing khams mthong:ma rig pa gti mug gi rtog sgrib dag sa sa rgyas rnam par snang mdzad kyi zhal mjal la:sku bde gshegs rigs kyi sa lam yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thobs po:dri lnga'i dbang bskur ba'i ma rigs nyon mongs pa'i las tshogs las grol:tshad med dga' ba chen po rgyud la skye:nub phyogs bde ba chen po'i zhings khams mthong:srid zhen 'dod chags kyi rtogs sgrib dag:sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi zhal mjal:gsung pad+ma rigs kyis sa lam dang yon tan bsam

gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan no: snying po lnga'i dbang bskur bas bag chags las bskyed pa'i phung lnga'i nyes pa las grol: tshad med pa'i ye shes chen po rgyud la skye byang phyogs las rab rdzogs pa'i zhings khams mthong: nyon mongs pa phrag tog gi sgrib pa dag: sangs rgyas don yod grub pa'i zhal 'jal: phrin las las rab rigs kyi sa lam dang yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa thob par 'gyur ro: rin chen lnga'i dbang bskur bas mngon rlom 'dod yon lnga'i nyes pa las grol tshad med byams pa chen po rgyud la skye: lho phyogs dpal ldan bkod pa'i zhing khams mthong las nyon nga rgyal gyi sgrib pa dag: sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung ldan gyis zhal mjal: yon tan rin chen rigs kyi sa lam dang pon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang ldan nas rgyud lnga'i 'gro ba mtha' dag 'dren pa'i dgos pa yod do: de nas zha khro'i lha dbang zhu phyir maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol gdab ni kye ho: bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa yis: bdag cags skal ldan slob bu la rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyis: lha dbang yongs rdzogs bskur du gsol: lan gsum zhus mthar rdo rje slob dpon he ru na'i chas

ra rdo: su zhug zhi khro'i lha tsag brtan ye rdzogs kya lha ngo sprod pa dang bcas te dbang bskur ba na kun bzang yab yum kya sku gtad la shā skal ldan rigs kyis bu rnams la kun bzang yab yum dbang bskur bas: gnyis 'dzin spros pa ka dag nas: chos sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog dharma ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa a: smon lam ni ho chos sku gdod ma'i mgon po yab yum gyi dbang bskur bas: gshes lug ma bcos gdod ma'i sangs rgyas yab yum gyis rang zhal mngon sum du rtog par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams kun bzang yab yum kyang gzhan na med de: rang rig 'gags med dwangs gsal ci yi ngo bor ma grub pa ni yab kun tu bzang po'o: de'i rang bzhin ye nas ka dag spros mtha' bral ba'i dbyings nyid yum kun tu bzang mo'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyur cig rigs lnga'i sku thogs la sno skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la rgyal ba rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phung po lnga po gnas dag nas: longs sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: o (ཿ su e hā saṃ bha ka ya bhi ṇiñtsa hūṃ: smon lam ni ho bcom ldan 'das bde

gshegs rigs lnga'i dbang bskur bas mtshan 'dzin phung lnga'i spros pa rnam par dag te bde gshegs rigs lnga'i rang zhal mthong nas 'gro don thogs pa med par 'byung bar gyur cig ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams rgyal ba rigs lnga yang gud na mi dmigs de: gzugs phung rnam par dag pa ni rnam par snang mdzad do: tshor phung rnam par dag pa ni rin chen 'byung ldan no: 'du shes rnam par dag ni snang ba mtha' yas so: 'du byed rnam par dag pa ni don yod grub pa'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: yum lnga' sku thogs la sa skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: yum chen lnga yis dbang bskur bas: 'byung ba ma spangs gnas dag nas 21ngas sku yum lnga'i dbang thob regag:snye lo me paṃ te: dharma a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ: smon lam ni ho: dbyings phyugs ye shesayum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: phyi nang gi 'byung ba'i khams rnam par dag nas rgyal ba thams cad bskyed pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dbyings kyi yum chen lnga yang gud na med de: phyi nang gi 'byung ba lnga ma spangs rnam par dag pa

ra/: nyid yum lnga'i rang bzhin no: de yang sems dang nam mkha'i khams rnam par dag pa ni dbying phyug ma'o: chu dang khrag gi khams rnam par dag pa ni ma zhi dkar mo'o: sa dang sha yi khams rnam par dag pa ni spyan ma ser mo'o: me dang drod kyi khams rnam par dag pa ni gos dkar dmar mo'o: rlung dang dbugs khams rnam par dag pa ni sgrol ma ljang mo'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig sems dpa' brgyad kyi sku gtad la (ཿ skal ldan regs kyi bu rnams la: sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:tshogs brgyad rtogs pa rnam dag nas sems dpa' rab 'byams dbang thob re ga: bho dhi sa twa a ṣiñtsa hūṃ: spron lam ni ho byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas:tshogs brgyad kyi rtogs pa rnam par dag nas byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus par gyur cig ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams sems dpa' brgyad kyang gud na med de: rang gi rnams shes tshogs brgyad 'gags med du gsal ba 'di ka byang chub sems dpa' brgyad do: de yang gzugs 'gags med du

mthong mkhan gyi mig shes 'di ni sa yi snying po'o: sgra 'gags med du tshor mkhan gyi rna shes 'di ni nam mkha'i snying po'o: dri 'gags med du tshor mkhan gyi sna shes 'di ni spyan ras gzigs so: ro 'gags med du myong mkhan gyi lce shes 'di ni phyag na rdo rje 'o: reg bya 'gags med du myang mkhan gyi lus shes 'di ni byams pa mgon po 'o: yid shes 'gags med du gsal ba'i dran rigs 'di ka sgrib pa rnams sel lo nyon mongs pa'i shes pa 'gags med du gsal ba'i ngar 'dzin khur re ka kun tu bzang po'o kun bzhi'i rnams shes 'gags med du gsal ba'i khyab brdal gyi mkhyen cha 'di 'jam dpal gyi rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig semasam brgyad kyi sku gtad la: shā skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad rtog pa rnam dag nas: sems ma rab 'byams dbang thob sgo ga: dz+nya na dhartu a ṣiñtsa nyu: smon lam na ho: byang chub sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur ba'i: yul brgyad kyi rtogs pa rnam par dag nas byang chub sems ma brgyad kyi 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus par gyur

ra sdo cig: ro sprod na 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams sems ma brgyad kyang gud na med de: phyi nang gi yul brgyad ma spangs rnam par dag pa ni byang chub sems ma brgyad do: de yang gzugs su snang ba ma spangs gnas su dag pa sgegs ma dkar mo'o: sgra ru grags pa ma spangs gnas su dag pa ni phreng ba ma ser mo'o: dri ru snom pa ma spangs gnas su dag pa ni glu dbyangs ma dmar mo'o: ro ru myong ba ma spangs gnas su dag pa ni gasma ri ljang gu'o: 'das pa'i rtogs pa rnam par dag pa ni puṅge ma dkar mo'o:ma 'ongs pa'i rtogs pa rnam par dag pa ni dhu pe ma ser mo'o: da ltar rtog pa rnam par dag pa ni a lo ke dmar mo'o 'byung ba ma nges pa'i rtogs pa dang chos can gyi khams rnam par dag pa ni ghasnye ljang mo'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyi shig: thub drug gi sku gam la / skal ldan rigs kyibu rnams la: thub chen drug gis dbang bskur bas:nyon mongs drug po gnas dag nas: sprul sku rab 'byams dbang thob shog: nir ma ka ya a snyi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni ho bcom ldan 'das thub pa drug gi dbang bskur bas

dug lnga ser sna dang drug rnam par dag ste: sprul pa rab 'byams kyis rigs drug 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ro sprod ni 'o skal ldan regs kyi bu rnams thub pa drug kyang gud na med de: nyon mongs pa rnams ma spangs gnas su dag pa ni sprul sku thub pa drug go: de yang nga rgyal rnam par dag pa ni dbang po brgya phyin no: 'dod chags rnam par dag pa ni shākya seng ge'o: phrag tog rnam par dag pa ni thag bzang ris so: gti mug rnam par dag pa ni seng ge rab brtan no: ser sna rnam par dag pa ni kha 'bar dhe wa'o: zhe sdang rnam par dag pa ni chos kyis rgyal po'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: sgo ba bzhis sku gtad la (ཿ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ba bzhi yi dbang bskur bas rtag chad mu bzhi rnam dag nas: phrin las bzhi yi dbang thob shog:shidz+nya puṣ+ṭi: wa sa: ma ra ya phaṭa: smon lam ni mthar byed sgo ba bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: rtag chad mu bzhi'i khams rnam par dag te: phrin las rnams pa bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni 'o 'thar byed sgo ba bzhi yang gud na

ram: med de: rtag chad mu bzhi rnam par dag pa nyid do: de yang ltag par lta ba gnas su dag pa ni rnam par rgyal ba'o: chad par lta ba gnas su dag pa ni gshin rje gshed do: bdag tu lta ba gnas su dag pa ni rta mgrin no: mtshan mar lta ba gnas su dag pa ni bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: sgo ma bzhi'i sku gtad la (ཿ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas skye gnas bzhi po gnas dag nas: tshad med rnams bzhi'i dbang zob re ga: 3 badz+ra aṅku pa sha spro ṭa gadhe a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni ho: ye shes sgo ma bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: skye gnas bzhi po gnas su dag nas tshad med rnams bzhi'i 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po byed nus par gyur cig: ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams sgo ma bzhi yang gud na med de: skye ba gnas bzhi rnam par dag pa ni sgo ma bzhi yin no: de yang brdzus skyes kyi rtogs pa rnam par dag pa ni lcags kyu ma dkar mo'o: mngal skyes kyi rtogs pa rnams par dag pa ni zhags pa ma ser mo'o: sgong skyes kyi rtogs pa rnam par dag pa ni lcags

sgrogs ma dmar mo'o: drod gsher las skyes pa'i rtogs pa rnam par dag pa ni dril bu ma ljang mo'i rang bzhin yin pa'i ngo shes par gyis shig: de nas khro bo' lha dbang bskur ba che mchog yab yum kyi sku gtad la (ཿ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: che mchog yab yum dbang bskul bas: ma rigs bdag 'dzin rnam dag nas: he ru ka dpal mngon gyur 31ga:oṃ ma hā dṛ he ru ka ma ha kro ti shwa ri a bhi ṣiñtsa a: smon lam ni ho khrag 'thung he ru ka che mchog yab yum kyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa'i 'khrul rtog rnam par dag nas:log 'dren bdud bgegs rnams 'dul ba'i dbang thob par gyur cig ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams che mchog yab yum kyang gzhan zhig yin snyam du ma sems shig: kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings ma byung ma skyes pa na rnam shes nyid du gsal ba ni yab che mchog he ru ga'o: phra mo rlung gi g.yo ba nyid kyi rnam par bskur ba ni yum dbang phyug kro ti shā ri ma'o: ye nas gnyis med bde ba chen por sangs rgyas pa ni: 'khor 'das kyi sprul gzhi 'pho med gtsug ma'i he ru ga'o don rtogs pa chos skur sangs ba yin pas

ra rdo: ngo shes par gyis shig khrag 'thung yab lnga'i sku gtad la /༷ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: khrag 'thung yab lnga'i dbang bskur bas 'khrul ba ma spangs gnas dag nas: he ru ka rnams mngon gyur shog o bhurnya badz+ra rat+na pad+ma garma he ru ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni ho ma hā pañtsa dṛ he ru ga'i dbang bskur bas: log rtogs nyon mongs rang gar spyod pa rnam par dag nas ye shes kyi dgongs spyod la spro nus pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams khrag 'thung rigs lnga yang mi dmigs te: log rtogs a 'thas kyi dri ma rnam par dag pa ni he ru ka sku lnga yin no: de yang bdag gir ma bzung ba'i shes pa ni budha he ru ga'o: de nye bar rag pa ni badz+ra he ru ga'o: phra bas nyams su myong ba ni rat+na he ru ga'o: rnam par gsal ba ni pad+ma he ru ga'o: bdag gir bzung ba ni garma he ru ga'o: rang bzhin yin bas chos nyid mnyam pa nyid du shes par gyis shig: dbang phyug yum lnga'i sku gtad la /༷ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la dbang phyug yum lnga'i dbang bskur bas: yul lnga'i rtogs pa gnas gyur te: kro ti yum

lnga'i dbang thob shog kro ti shwa ti pañtsa dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni sa ye shes khro mo rnams kyi dbang bskur bas yul kyi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag nas kro ti yum lnga'i dbyings la spyod pa'i dbang thob par gyur cig: ro sprod ni 'o rigs kyi bu rnams dbang phyug yum lnga yang gud na mi dmigs de: ye shes kyi rang mdangs nang dbyings su nub te de phyi gdang 'od kyi rnam par snang ba ni kro ti yum lnga'i rang bzhin no: de yang chos dbyings brdal khyab du snang ba ni budha kro ti ma'o: dag gsal rtog ma dang bral ba ni badz+ra kro ti ma'o: ma 'gags rnam par gsal ba ni rat+na kro ti ma'o: bde zhing rnams par rol ba ni pad+ma kro ti ma'o: g.yo zhing kun la 'phro ba ni garma kro ti mas rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: ko'u ru brgyad kyi sku gtad la shā skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: ko'u ru brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas gyur te: mkha' 'gro rab 'byams dbang thob re ga ha: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā smon lam ni sa dbyings phyugs khro mo brgyad gyi dbang bskur bas tshogs brgyad kyis 'khrul rtogs rnam par dag nas

rat+na: mkha' 'gro ma mo rab 'byams dbang du 'du bar gyur cig:ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la ma mo ko'u ri brgyad kyang gud na mi dmigs te kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings las dam tshig gi rjes su 'gro ba'i ma mo ko'u ri brgyad do de yang kun gzhi chos kyi dbyings la dam tshig gi rjes su 'gro ba'i ma mo ko'u ri ma dkar mo'o:'gyu ba 'gags med kyi dbyings la rlung gi rjes su 'gro ba'i tso'u ri ma ser mo'o:nyon mongs pa'i yid can gyi dbyings la rtogs pa dam tshig gi rjes su 'gro ba'i ma mo pra mo ha dmar mo'o:yid gsal dag gi dbyings la rtogs pa shes rab kyi 'gros ldan be ta ljang mo'o:snang stong 'gags med rol ba' mkha' la rang gsal shes pa gar gyi 'gros ldan puska ser skya'o:grags stong brjod med kyi mkha' la zhen bral 'od gsal ba'i shes pa stobs kyi 'gros ldan gasma ri sngo nag go:tshor stong zhen pa med pa'i mkha' la 'gags bral ye shes kyi gzigs pa mnyam par rol ba'i 'gros ldan tsaṇ+ḍa li ser nag go:myong stong bde ba chen po'i dbying sa la gang shar rol ba'i ting 'dzin can rme sha ni

mthing ga'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: seng ha brgyad kyi sku gtad la (ཿ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la sedha brgyad kyis dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad ma spang rang grol nas: phra min rab 'byams dbang thob shog: he a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni ho: phra min sed+ngha brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: yul brgyad kyi rtogs pa ma spangs rang sar grol te: phra min rab 'byams dbang du 'du bar gyur cig:ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams sed+ngha brgyad kyang gud na med de sems nyid ma byung ma skyes par 'du 'phro 'gags med du shar ba phra min seng ha ma brgyad yin no: de yang don dam par sems 'gags med shar ba ni seng ha skrug nag go: yul zhen du shar ba be kri dmar mo'o:yul yul can rten med grol ba ni sri la nag mo'o: nyon mongs pa'i rtogs pa 'dzin med du grol ba shwa na mthing nag go: bdag rtogs ru tra'i ro la rol ba'i kri ta ser nag go:yul snang 'khor ba'i mtshan ma 'ub chub du byed pa'i gang ka dmar nag go: gzung 'dzin gyis srog 'phrog pa'i kha khā mthing nag go: chos can chos nyid du sgrol ba'i hu lu mthing

ra rdo: gi rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyis shig: sgo ma bzhi'i sku gto la / skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur bas tshad med dgongs don mngon gyur nas phrin las bzhi la mnga' brtes shog: dza hūṃ rba ho a bhi ṣiñtsa a: smon lam ni lha rta gdong ye shes sgo ma bzhi'i dbang bskur bas: log bdud rnam par 'dul zhing tshad med pa'i brin las rab 'byams la mnga' brnyes par gyur cig ngo sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams rta gdong sgo ma bzhi gud na med do: skye gnas bzhi po yang bdud bzhi rnams par dag pa ni sgo ma bzhi'i rang bzhin no de yang lha bu'i bdud rnam par grol ba rta gdong dkar mo'o: 'chi bdag gi bdud rnam par grol ba phag gdong ser ma'o nyon mongs pa'i bdud rnam par grol ba seng gdong dmar mo'o: phung po'i bdud rnam par grol ba sbrul gdong ljang mo'i rang bzhin yin pas ngo shes par gyur cig: dbang phyug nyer brgyad sku gtad la shāḥ skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams la: dbang phyug nyer brgyad dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs rtogs tshogs rang grol nas ma mo rab

'byams dbang thob re ga: bh+yo: a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: smon lam ni ho dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas: nyon mongs pa'i rtogs tshogs rnams ma spangs rang sar grol nas: mkha' 'gro ma mo dam can thams cad sgog la mnga' brtes par gyur cig: ro sprod ni 'o skal ldan rigs kyi bu rnams dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyang gu na mi dmigs te nyon mongs pa'i rtogs tshogs ma spangs rang sar dag pa nyid dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad yin: de yang nam mkhar gnas pa'i ye shes ni srin mo spug nag go bde ba chen por gnas pa'i ye shes ni tshangs pa sbrul gdong ngo: longs spyod 'khor lo gnas pa'i ye shes ni lha chen gzigs gdong ngo: chos kyi 'khor lo'i ye shes nai sra gdong ngo:sprul pa'i gnas gyi ye shes ni gzhon nu dred mgo'o: srid par zhugs pa ye shes ni brgya phyin dom mgo'osnye 'dogs byed la gnas pa'i ye shes ni rdo rje khu byug dkar mo' ra bzhin de shar gyi ma drug go chosadabyings 'od gsal ba'i thig le ni rdo rje pha chang ngo: ro mnyam por 'bab pa'i thig le ni zhi ba chu srin no: dga' ba rgyas pa'i thig le ni

ra rdo: bdud rtsi sdig gdong ngo: ye shes gsal ba'i thig le ni zla ba khra mgo'o: gnas la sbyin pa'i thig le ni be con wa gdong ngo: mkha' gsang dgyes pa'i thig le ni srin mo stag gdong ngo: 'byung ba drod 'beb pa'i thig le ni rdo rje ra gdong ser mo'i ring bzhin de lho yis ma drug go gtum mo chos kyi dbyings ni za ba bya rgod do: gtum rngam mi shig pa'i dbyings ni dga' ba rta gdong ngo gtum 'bar tshangs pa'i me ni stobs chen khyung gdong ngo: gtum rol 'gyur med kyi bde gsang ni srin mo khya gdong ngo gtum pa rab g.yos me ni 'dod pa pu shud do: gtum rol rdo rje'i gar ni nor srung sha mgo'o: gtum mo mkha' la rol ba mo ni rdo rje seng gdong dmar mo'i rang bzhin de nub gyi ma drug go: khyab cing brdal ba'i g.yo ba ni rlung lha spyang gdong ngo: go skabs 'byed pa'i rlung ni mi mo skyin gdong ngo: rab 'bar bskul ba'i rlung ni phag mo phag gdong ngo:gnas su 'khyil ba'i rlung ni rdo rje kha gdong ngo: rnam par gnas pa'i rlung ni sna chen glang chen no kun la 'phro ba'i rlung ni chu lha sbrul gdong ngo: mkha' mnyam gsal ba'i rlung ni

rdo rje sbrul gdong ljang mo'i rang bzhin de byang gi ma drug go mdor na zhi khro rigs 'dzin rtsa ba gsum gyi dkyil 'khor sgyu las 'od kyi sbub na: 'od kyi sku la thugs ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor tshom bu shig se dngos su bzhugs nas yod do: gzhan yang rtsa thams cad ni dpal bo'i rang bzhin no: rlung thams cad ni dpa' mo'i rang bzhin no: thig le dkar cha thams cad bde ba chen po thabs kyi rang bzhin no rak+ta dmar cha thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid yum gyi dkyil 'khor ro: ba spu bye ba sa ya ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs so: de ltar skye gnas bar do kun bzang yab yum gnyis med kyi dgongs pa mnyam la zhi khro rab 'byams nang gsal gyi tshul du bzhugs so: bsam bstan bar dor thugs rjes zer mdangs zhi lhag gi dpal 'tshor 'od stong brdal nas nyon shes kyi bag chags sbyong bar byed do: 'chi kha bar do sku gsum lam snang du shar nas dbu ma chos kyi skur dbyings rig kha sbyor du 'pho: ro ma bde chen gyi dbyings sprul sku sgyu ma lta bu 'dren pa'i ded dpon chen por 'pho bar byed do: de ltar rtsal ma rdzogs kyang chos nyid

༄8: bar dor zhi khro'i lha tshogs lus las thon te nam mkha' bar snang gang bar 'char ro: 'di'i dus su rig pa 'od la 'jug pa 'od rig pa la nub pa gnyis med 'od gsal du 'dres par gyur de nang dbyings chos sku'i dgongs klong du btsan sa zin par 'gyur ro: de ltar lhun grub sgo brgyad kyi char grol bar ma gyur na sgra 'od zer gsum 'jigs rngam bzod dka'i gnas srid pa bar do'i snang char mchod de: de yi tshe 'od thams cad rang 'od 'od gsal gyi dkyil 'khor: zer thams cad rig pa'i rang zer rdo rje lug gu rgyud: sgra thams cad grags stong gsung chos kyi rol mo: mngon par shes rab drug dang: rjes su dran pa'i ting 'dzin drug gis srid pa'i gnas stong: bag chags kyi sbub sgrol: rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i gras su 'god thabs mchog gsang ba sngags rdo rje bla med kyi byin brlabs dbang mchog kho na la rag las so: de nas rang lus rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor la: brnyes pa dang: los chos dang: dka' thub dang gtsang smer blta ba dang: nyon mongs pa'i nyes tshogs kyi rgud pa ma bcug

par: bza' btung tshogs 'khor: 'dod yon ro mnyams: gos rgyan zhen med snang grags dran rig thams cad chos nyid mnyams pa nyid kyi 'khor lo ru longs spyod par gyur cig: de lta ra zhi khro'i lha dbang 'dis 'gro drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo kheg nyon mongs nyes tshogs gtan nas dag rag 'dzan rgyal ba'i zhang du 'khod: don gnyisalhun grub gdon mi za sa ma yā e ma rgyal dbang pad+ma'i thugs khrag mchog las lngan bu ya spyod yul 'ad dwags sgam lha yi dge bsnyen da dpa la ldan brag lha mgon po la zhi khro zos grol gtad rgyas sbyin ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga ya dus u rgyan phran las sprul pa yis zhi khro dgongs pa rang grol gyis bye ma'i grangs kya 'gro ba 'dren de bzhin ngan so dongs sprug kyas gdul zhang gsungs gi sprul pa 'i 'dren bka' 'ad thugs sras dpal du shog dam nyamasalag tu ma shor cig sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda' thim snyices pa'ang nye gnas mkhar los yang ya bskur ngor 7kho bo rig 'dzan 'ja' lus rdo rje' se brag g.yu'i yis ral gsang nas brtan pa'i bdo' res las bsgyur ba dge legs 'phel maṅgale/

ra rdo: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las: zhi khro ngan song dong sprugs kyis: gtor dbang reg tshad rnams grol bzhugs so:༄8: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo ༄12111༷ yi dam zha khro rab 'byams kyis skal ldan smin par bya ba la dab la gyis gtor chen thog byas de 'o dad pa dam tshag dang ldan pa'i bu slob rnams ma yengs par nyon cig: gtor snod dur khrod thod mkhar me rlu 'tshub ma'i dbus su: gtor ma 'od kyi tshangs khang 'khrig pa'i 1nga du bka' rgyud rig 'dzin bla ma sprin phung 'khrigs pa: rab 'bar me rlung gi 'tshubs ma chen po 'khyil ba'i klong ni zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshom bu 'tshogs pa: 'dab na 'ja' sprin gyi gur phub pa'i dbus su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma mngon sum du bzhugs par gsal btab pa'i sku yi cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi 'od zer dang bcas pa lan gsum spros nas skal ldan rnams la thim pas: dang po'i sdig sgrib rnams dag: gnyis pa'i lus gang shing gnas gsum du 'bru gsum gyis brgyan: gsum pas dbang dang dngos grub

thams cad thob par bsam la: o.ā sa chos dbyings skye 'gags 'gyur med gzhong pa na 'od gsal lhun grub snang ba'i gtor chen bshams: rol stsal ma 'gags sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras: rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: skal ldan rig gyi bu la dbang bskur bas: sku gsung thugs kyi byin brlabs reg pa'i mod: skye gnas bar dor thos bsam bsgom mthar byin: rmi lam bar do 'khrul snang rang sar dag: bsam bstan bar dor rig pa rang gdeng thob 'chi kha bar do'i thim rim rang ngo shes:chos nyid bar do'i 'od gsal 'bras bur smin: srid pa bar do 'jigs las dbugs dbyung zhing: rang gzhan don gnyis 'bad med 'grub pa dang sku gsum lhun gyi grub pa'i dbang thob shog: ka gu ru dhe wa ḍak+ki ni sarba sirnyi pha la a snyi ṣiñtsa o.ā hūṃ hrī: smon lam ni ma.ā hūṃ chos sku gdod ma'i mgon po longs sku rigs lnga gangs chen sprul sku lag na rdo rje rig 'dzin dga' rab rdo rje: mkhas grub dṛ sedha: rig 'dzin dz+nya na su tra: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dgyes sde grub pa'i rgyal mo: lang gro dkon mchog

༄8: 'byung gnas: nga lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs: grub dbang khye'u chung lo tsā rig 'dzin 'ja' lus rdo rje drin chen rtsa brgyud bla ma: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi lha tshogs: 'bar ba khrag 'thung khro bo' dkyil 'khor: dag pa brgyud gsum rigs 'dzin gyi lha tshogs: bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis dengs 'dir rdo rje'i slob ma rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi byin gyis rlobs la dbang mchog bskur du gsol nyams chags sdig sgrib dag par mdzad du gsol: nad gdon bar chad zhi bar mdzad du gsol: nyams rtogs yon tan 'phel bar mdzad du gsol: 'chi kha chos kyis sku ru sangs rgyas par mdzad du gsol: bar do long sa spyod rdzogs par sku mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par mdzad du gsol skye ba sprul ba'i sku gzhan don phrin las dang bcas pa 'byung bar mdzad du gsol rig drug 'khor ba'i skye sgo kheg par mdzad du gsol: khams gsum 'khor ba dongs nas sprug nus par mdzad du gsol: o ā:kaka ka dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhartu ā: o ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo 〉: ka ya a bhi ṣiñtsa

skye wak+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā tsit+ta a ṣiñtsa 〉ཿsarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sdi gnas gsum rtsa ba gsum du gsal dbang bzha blangs shing dngos grub rol tshag chung don che byin rlabs myur skal ba ༅ gyilodapal du shog sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya gu rgya brda zim thizhes pa 'ang nye gnas mkhar lo' bskur ngor rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje'i spel ba dge legs 'aze la sarba ma lo ༄〈: nyu skal ldan rig kyibu rnams la:rgyal srid sna bdun dbang bskur bas:bde legs phun sum 'tshogs pa dang:'phags pa'i nor bdun phyugs nas kyang:gzhan don dpag med 'grub par shog:pra pe rat+na.a bhi ṣiñtsa :nyu skal ldan rig kyibu rnams la bkra shis rtag brgyad dbang bskur bas:rgyal bu rgyal sar bton nasakyang:rgyal 'bang mnga' 'og tshud pa ltar:dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs thob nas:gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa shog:uṣ+ṭa maṅga le a bhi ṣiñtsa /

rngo zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las: zhi khro ngan song dong sprug kyi: mdun bskyed bum pa'i sgrub pa 'brel tshad rang grol zhes bya ba bzhugs so:ra rdo: kun bzang zhi khra'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo casazla cug/ rnams bum bla med so lnga'i gtams dal bkod rnam lnga snyer spyod bkrams bdag nyid la gsal ting 'dzin gyis mdun bskyed bum pa sgrub pa na oṃ a dṛ ta hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs snyed swā bha wa shudha sbyangs stong palingang las rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa rnams rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa: nang gzhal med khang sgo gru rta bab rgyan dang bkod pa thams cad ma 'dres shing yongs su rdzogs pa: phyi nang gsal ba 'od kyi tshangs khang 'byugs pa'i dbus su chu dang bcud thams cad phun sum tshogs par gtam pa'i klob : 'od lnga zlum 'khyil gyi sbubs su dkyil 'khor yongs kyi gtso bo chos sku kun bzang yab yum: de 'og seng ge glang rta rma bya shing shing gi btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i khar: bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dang yum dbyings phyug ma: dpal rnam par snang mdzad dang yum ma ma ki thabs rin chen

'byung ldan yum sangs rgyas spyan ma yab snang ba mtha' yas dang yum gos dkar mo: lha don yod grub pa dang yum dam tshig sgrol ma rnams longs sku'i rgyan cha lugs rdzogs shing g.yas rnams rigs lngas phyag mtshan dang: g.yon dril bu sku la brten cing 'ja' 'od kyi gur khang 'khrigs klong zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis rol pa'o: de rgyab pad+ma 'dab ma bcu drug la byang chub sems dpa' brgyad dang sems ma brgyad rnams phyag mtshan rang rtags 'dzin cing zhabs phyed dkyil gyi pad zlar rol ba la rgyan bcu gsum rnam par bkra ba'o: de rgyab 'dab ma bcu la bcom ldan 'das thub pa drug sprul sku'i sangs rgyas kyi cha lugs la dbu gtsug tor can phyag rang rtags dang bcas te zhabs bzhengs pa'i thabs kyi rol ba rig 'jin rnams pa bzhi rgyan drug dar dpyangs he ru ga'i cha lugs can ḍa dril 'khrol zhing rdo rje'i gar bsgyur ba dang bcas te rigs kyi yum rnams dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o: de rgyab sgo bzhi la mthar byed yab yum brgyad gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'byud cing pad nyi rū tri'i khar gyad kyis rol bar mdzad pa la me dang

ra rdo: rlung gi tshwa tshwa 'phro ba'o: zhi ba'i gdongs rten med kyi nam mkha' la rab 'jigs bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshubs ma'i dbus su dpal che mchog he ru ka dang yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug ma: de 'og khrag 'thung badz+ra he ru ka yab yum mthing nag: shar phyogs su budha he ru ka yab yum smug nag: lho ru rat+na he ru ka yab yum ser nag nub tu pad+ma he ru ka yab yum dmar nag byang du garma he ru ka yab yum ljang nag: kun kyang gar dgu'i nyams kyis 'khrud cing dur khrod dpa' bas chas kyis klubs pa phyag mtshan rang rtags 'dzin cing rngam brjed bltar mi bzod pa'i sku can no: de rgyab 'khor lo rtsibs bcu drug la gnas kyi ko'u ri ma mo brgyad dang: yul gyi phra min seng ha brgyad rnams rdzu 'phrul rol gar ya ma zung sna tshogs dang bcas te rol pa'o: de rgyab 'jigs rngams srin mo khros pa'i rnam 'gyur can sgo ma bzhi dang dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad rnams brjid pa'i lus la rnam rol sna tshogs kyi gar dang bcas te bzhugs pa'o: zhi khro'i lha de dag gi steng 'og bar gsum thams cad la mgron thabs kyi lha bka'

brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyud sde dang sgrub sde'i sprin rab 'byams 'bum phrag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdo rje chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams mngon du bzhugs par gsal gdab: lha tshogs de rnams kyi gnas gsum 31 āḥ/ dang dam tshig gi thugs sgog lcags kyu lta bu las 'od zer 'phros te rang bzhin 'og min chos dbyings dur khrod me ru 'bar ba nas ye shes pa'i tshogs kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa ltar spyan drangs la dam tshig bskyed pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams la sib sib bstem mo: gzhung ltar spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol phyag bstod spros mthar 'dzab dmigs rang nyid kun bzang yab yub kyi thugs srog sngags 'phreng las 'od zer mchod pa'i tshul can spros te: mdun bskyed bum pa'i lha tshogs kyi thugs rgyud bskul: kun gyi sku gsung thugs las 'od zer steng 'og phyogs 'tshams thams cad du 'phros: rgyal ba'i zhing rab 'byams thams cad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa phul: de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyis byin rlabs bsdus te bum war thim yang 'od zer dpag tu med pa khams gsum gyi gnas su 'phros

ra rdo: 'gro ba rig drug gi sems can thams cad la phog pas dmyal ba tsha grangs: yi dwag bkres skom: dud 'gro blun rmongs: mi skye rga na 'chi: lha ma yin 'thab rtsod: lha 'pho lhung gi sdug bsngal dang sdig sgrib ma lus pa sbyangs nas thams cad kyang zhi khro rtsa ba gsum gyi sku 'ba' zhig tu gyur de: rin po che'i gzhal med khang yang shing rgya che bar la tshogs dam pa rigs brgya'i snying po sngags sgra ti ri ri sgrogs par bsam la bla a li ka li dz+nyā na sa twa kro ta mu ne+e ye swā hā: sa sto dhi tset+ta ma hā su kha dz+nya na dhartu a:sa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ: dab zhi slad du dz+nyā na kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa sidhi hūṃ swā hā: zhes 'dogs gshin don ma ma koling sa man+ta dmigs yul gyis lus sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad shirnye ku ru swā hā: zhes 'dogs nyams chags sbyong phyir nyams chags sdeg sgob thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye swā hā mthar sngags kyis mchod ci bstod mthar bum lha bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs rnams kyis slob ma'i rgyud la dbang gi rtogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bskyed du gsol zhes gsol ba btab tshe zag med ye

shes kyi rang bzhin bdud rtsi chu rgyun gyi bum pa gang ba'i dbus lha rnams 'od kyi skur bzhugs par bsam: de ltar rnam rgyal bum pa nyid bskyed cing bzlas la dbang phyin phab de nas gang la gang 'dul gyis las de 'bad med lhun kyi grub sa ma wā rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag lha mgon po' bsrungs 'dod sred can la mi 'chor bar dam ldan thugs sras tshogs la sprod 'brel tshad rigs 'dzin sa thob shog gu gye bdo zim lhazhesapa'ang nye gnas mkhar lo na yang yang nan tan chen po' bskur ro ra / kho bo klong gsal nam mkha'i rnal 'byor rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rjes rgya rong brag lha mgon po'i gnas mdun seng brag g.yu yi ral gsang nas bton pa'i mkha' 'gro'i brda ris las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis sarba masgo lo/ skyid badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya brarnya rat+na pad+ma sa twa garma hūṃ badz+ra he ru ka brnya he ru rat+na he ru pad+ma he ru garma he ru gang ga nyams chags sgrib sogs dang mthar las bzhi'i 'dzab kha bsgyur ba nad gdon 'jigs brgyad tshe bsod dpal 'khor 'das srid gnod byed dgra bgegs dbyangs gsal yig brgya rten snying bcas mthar mchod bstod 31 badz+ra arnya sogs bstod pa ni hūṃ hrī: chos sku mkha' ltar dri med dag pa la: gzugs sku 'gags med 'od dang
