ra rdo: zer bzhin brdal:sprul sku gzhan phan phrin las 'ja' ltar 'khyugs:kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod:dngos grub ni hūṃ trī mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa la:ji lta ji snyed mkhyen gzigs dngos grub stsol:rtsa sngags dngasarba sirnyipha la hrī:dgob 'di yis sogs bsto smon bya'o
ra rdo: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhi khro ngan song dongs sprugs kyis bstan bsrung dam can sde bdun gyi bskang gsol bdud dpung rang grol bzhugs:

ra/ kun bzang zhi lo lha la phyag 'ayi lo ma shas rgyun gtor skyem phud sbyang bsgyur spel lha gsal ting 'dzin brtan po yis stong pa'i ngang las dur khrod thod mkhar dbus: rin chen khri rkang pad nyi bdud bzhi'i khar: bdag nyid dpal chen che mchog he ru ga: gar dgu'i nyams 'khyud dur khrod dpal chas klubs dbyings phyugs kro ti yum dang gnyis med 'khril: ye shes khro bo'i lha tshogs spyan drangs bstims mdun du pad nyi dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i khar: dpal mgon ma ning 'chol khros mthing nag rngams: g.yas g.yon phyag 'tshan ru mtshon snying zhags bsnams: dar nag ber gsol snying sbul thod phreng brgyan rab 'jigs bskal ba'i me rlung 'tshub dbus 'gying:g.yas su sngags bsrung g.yon du dpa' 'bar ma: shar du sgog bdud lto ru gza' bdud rgyal: nub tu rdor legs byang du gnod sbyin dmar rang rang gtso 'khor sprul pa g.yog dang bcas: lha dang mi yi khrom tshogs lta bur bskyed: thugs sgog las spros dam tshig lcags kyu yis dam can sde bdun 'khor bcas gnyis med bstims: spyan 'dren

ra rdo: ni (ཿ chos kyidabyengs nas sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs pa log rtogs 'dul mdzad sangs rgyas bstan bsrung mchog: dpal mgon ma ning gtso 'khor g.yog dang bcas: dam tshig gsang ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: bla badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs gsol ni (ཿ rab 'dzogs dur khred pad nyi dgra bgegs khar: lha chen dpal 'bar ma ning gtso 'khor bcas: sngon gyi dam dgongs sgrub mchog skyong ba'i phyir: ma lus dam la dgongs bzhin bzhugs su gsol:sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ni (ཿ yeshes dang nilas la grub pa yis: dam can sde bdun rang rang g.yog 'khor bcas: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba'i dam dgongs nas bdag gi lha phyag 'tshal lo brtse ba'i skyongs:na mo sa ma ya ho: mchod pa mi (ཿ bla ma yidam zhi khro rab 'byams dang: mkha' 'gro dam can sde bdun 'khor bcas la phyi nang gsang mchod sman rag ba listo: dam sgong ga na tsakra'i mchod pa 'bul: dgyes bzhes sangs rgyas bstan pa srung ba dang: rnal 'byor bzhed don ma lus grub mdzod cig ma hwa sarba pañtsa pā dza kha hi: a

dṛ ta rak+ta ba lirnya ga na tsakra la kha hi: bshags pa na (ཿ ye shes las grub dam can rgya mtsho dang: dpal mgon ma ning dregs pa sde drug dgongs: bdag rmongs dam tshig chags nyams mchod rdzas chung : thugs 'gal nongs pa gang song mthol lo bshags: phyu badz+ra sa ma ya ā: bstod pa ni / byin rlabs dngos grub 'dod ster dam tshig can: ma la yar gnas gsang sngags bstan srung ba: ru hra sde gsum dpung tshogs 'joms mdzad pa'i: dpal mgon ma ning 'khor dang bcas la bstod: bskul ba ni hūṃ bye ma naing nag po yang 'khor brgyad: pho rgyud thams cad dgra la bh+yo: e ka dza ṭi ma mo 'bum: smug nag 'khor bcas dur khrod lha mo dpal 'bar ma: sngags srung mo rgyud shan pa mi srun srin mo'i sku: srog sgrub 'khor bcas dgra la gza' bdud chen po gdong mo bzhi: drang srong 'khor bcas dgra la bh+yo: skyes bu dam can rdo rje legs dge bsnyen 'khor bcas shan pa dmar nag srog gi bdag: gnod sprin 'khor bcas bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde snyid gzhi: bka' 'khor sprul bcas dgra la bh+yo stes bu dam can sde bdun

ra rdo: po: dmar gtor khrag skyems 'di bzhes la: do nub sdang ba'i dgra la rgyug: bsad rtags don snying khyer la shog mngo na spyod drag po'i khyad chos ston dgra bdud ming med phrin las mdzod: phran bcol ni kyi: dpal mgon ma ning gtso dang 'khor: e ka tsa ti dpal 'bar ma srog bdud nag po gza' bdud rgyal: rdo rje legs pa gnod sbyin tshogs: 'khor dang g.yog bcas dgongs su gsol bdag ni ma rig dbang gyur te sgrub rdzas gtor ma ma 'byer zhing ting 'dzin byi rmug 'thib pa'i rkyon:dus su ma bskang 'byer tshogs chung : mdze bo yug sa'i grib phob sogs: thugs 'gal nongs pa mthol lo bshags: lta ba zab mo mthong ba dang: sgom pa'i ting 'dzin gsal ba dang: spyod pa zhib mo mthar phyin nas 'bras bu rig 'dzin mchog thob mdzod: rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'dzin nus shing: yongs la phan bde spel ba dang: dgra bgegs thal bar brlags la thegags: phrin las rab 'khumams sku ngas dza/ba mdzod: zab chos 'od gsal snyag thig ga brtan pa yar ngos zla ltar spel de 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe bsrang bshad bsgrub

mdzad pa mthar phyin te bkra shis phan bde'i char 'bebs mdzod de ltar bskang gsol byed pa'i ma' phrin las rab 'byams lhun grub cing sa lam nyam rtogs mthar phyan nas don gnyis lhun 'grub gdod mi za sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag lha mgon po' srung nga sprul thugs gras dpal du shog gu gye brda thim snyizhes pa'ang nye gnas mkhar lo'i yang yang bskur ngor 7bdag 'dra rig 'dzan 'ja' lus rdo rje'i rgya rong brag lha mgon po' gnasamadun seng brag gamu yi ral gsang nasabaton pa'i brda ras las bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shes par gyur cig sarba masgo la

( rat+na: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhikhro ngan song dongs sprug kyis phyag 'tshal sdig sgrib rang grol bzhugs so:ra /: kun bzang nakhro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo rwa1ze rtsa nakhro rab 'byam mdun mkhar gsal khyed shes dad pa drag po yis lus ni brkyangs phyag brdab te 'tshal ngag gi zhi khro'i mtshan brjod cing gnyen po stobs bzha tshangs bapo pas na mo gdod malisangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur ba'i dbyings: kun bzang rdul dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo: rnams pa kun gyi mchog ldan de bzhin nyid dbyings yum kun bzang mo la phyag 'tshal lo: kun gzhi gzug phung gti mug rnam dag pa: bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad la phyag 'tshal: rnams shes zhen 'dzin zhe sdang rnams dag pa: dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal: tshor phung nga rgyal rtogs pa rnam dag pa: yon tan rin chen 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal: 'du shes 'dod chags mtshan 'dzin rnam dag pa: bde mchog snang ba mtha' yas la phyag 'tshal: 'du byed phrag dog 'khrul rlung rnam dag pa: yang dag don yod grub pa la phyag

'tshal: nam mkha' rnam dag sangs rgyas rigs kyi dbyings: yum mchog de bzhin nyid la phyag 'tshal lo: chu khams rnam dag rdo rje rigs kyi dbyings: yul mchog ma ma ki la phyag 'tshal lo: sa khams rnam dag rin chen rigs gyi dbyings: yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan la phyag 'tshal lo me khams rnam dag pad+ma rigs kyi dbyings yum mchog gos dkar mo la phyag 'tshal lo: rlung khams rnam dag lus kyi rigs kyi dbyings: yum mchog dam tshig sgrol la phyag 'tshal lo: mig gi rnams shes ma spangs rnam dag pa:sa yi snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo rna ba'i rnam shes ma spangs rnam dag pa byams pa mi dra'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo: sna yi rnams shes ma spab sa rnam dag pa kun tu bzang po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: lce yi rnam shes ma spangs rnam dag pa: nam mkha'i snying po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: lus kyi rnams shes ma spangs rnam dag pa spyan ras gzigs dbang zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo yid kyi rnams shes ma spangs rnam dag pa 'phags pa 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo nyon yid rnams

ra rdo: shes ma spangs rnam dag pa sgrib pa rnam sel zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: kun gzhi'i rnams shes ma spangs rnam dag pa: phyag na rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: gzugs su snang ba ma spangs gnas dag pa: lā phye dkar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: 'das pa'i rtog pa ma spangs gnas dag pa lha mo puṅge ma la phyag 'tshal lo: sgra ru snang ba ma spangs gnas dag pa: ma phye ser mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: ma 'ong rtogs pa ma spangs gnas dag pa lha mo dhu pe ma la phyag 'tshal lo:tri ru sna ba ma spangs rnam dag pa girti dmar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'chal lo: da lta'i rtogs pa ma spangs gnas dag pa: lha mo a lo ke la phyag 'tshal lo ro ru snang ba ma spangs gnas dag pa: nirti ljang mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: ma nges rtog pa ma spangs rnam dag pa lha mo gadhe ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rtag par lta ba ma spangs rnam dag pa:rnam par rgyal ba' zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: chad par lta ba ma spangs rnam dag pa: gshin rje gshed po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag tu lta ba ma spangs rnam dag pa: rta

mgrin rgyal po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: mtshan mar lta ba ma spangs rnam dag pa bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: tshad med snyeng rje'i 'gro ba gnas nas 'dren: lcags kyu dkar mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo tshad med byams pa'i 'gro ba 'dor med 'chings: zhags pa ser mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo: tshad med dga' ba'i 'gro ba 'khrul med sdom lcags sgrogs dmar mo'i shadas la phyag 'tshal lo: tshad med btang snyoms 'gro ba ras med skyongs: dril bu ljang mo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo:nga rgyal rnam dag lha yi 'jig rten 'dren: bcom ldan dbang po brgya byin la phyag 'tshal: 'dod chags rnam dag mi yi 'jig rten 'dren: bcom ldan shākya thub pa la phyag 'tshal: phrag dog rnam dag lha min 'jig rten 'dren: bcom ldan thag bzang ras nyid la phyag 'tshal gti mug rnam dag dud 'gro'i 'jin rten 'dren: bcom ldan seng ge rab brtan la phyag 'tshal: ser sna rnam dag yi dwag 'jig rten 'dren bcom ldan kha 'bar de wa la phyag 'tshal zhe sdang rnam dag dmyal ba'i 'jin rten 'dren: bcom

ra rdo: ldan chos kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal: dkyil 'khor kun gtso byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter: rig 'dzin yab yum rnam dag la phyag 'tshal lo kun tu bzang po che mchog he ru ga: khrag 'thung che mchog sku la phyag 'tshal lo: stong nyid gar dbang 'khor ba gnas nas 'dren: kro ti shwa ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: gti mug rdo rje'i rmongs sems sangs bar byed: bud+dha he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: zhe sdang rdo rje'i snying rje'i 'gal zla gzhom badz+ra he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo nga rgyal rdo rje'i nyon mongs gnas stong byed: rat+na he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: 'dod chags rdo rje'i bde chen ye shes sbyin: pad+ma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: phrag dog rdo rje'i gabrul snang ka dag byed: karma he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo bdogashadags phrin las gdul bya'i yul la 'gyed: brnya kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rdo rje'i mdzad pa'i 'khor ba kha lo bsgyur: badz+ra kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: rin chen dgos 'byung yon tan bskyed mdzad pa'i: rat+na kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: bde ba dbang mdzad chags pa'i gnas stong byed pad+ma kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo

snyoms pa chen po 'khor 'das gnyis med sbyor: karma kro ti ma la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dkar mo zhing dbyug bhan dmar 'dzin: rol mdzad ko ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo khro mo ser mo snang stong mda' gzhi 'gengs: 'dren mdzad tso'u ri ma la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dmar mo chu srin rgya mtshan phyar: 'dul mdzad pra mo ha la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo mthing nag rdo rje'i bhan dmar dkrugs: stobs mdzad be+e ta li la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo dmar ser rgyu ma 'dren cing rol: sbor mdzad puk+ka si la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ljang nag rdo rje bhan+ta bsre: bsgyur mdzad ghasma ri la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo ser skya tsit+ta bam chen za: sgrol mdzad tsartse li la phyag 'tshal lo: khro mo sngo nag bam ro mgo lus phral: bsre mdzad sme sha ni la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag seng ge'i mgo can kha ro thog: sing ha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis mthil du bsnol: bya kṛ mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: nag mo wa gdong spu gri mkha' la phyar: sri la mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo: mthing nag spyang mo'i gdo can rba ro phyar shwa na mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo

ra/: ser nag bya rgod mgo can ba su 'dren:kri ta mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo dmar mo dur bya'i gdong can zhing phrag khyer:kaṅka mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo nag mo bya rog gdong can bhan gri 'dzin kha kha mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo:sngo nag 'ug pa'i gdong can lcags kyu bsdams:hu lu mu kha ma la phyag 'tshal lo:rig drug stong khams gnas nas sgrol mdzad pas:sbor byed chen po brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo:sgogs bcas bdud tshogs lcags kyu'i 'dren mdzad pas sgo ma rta gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo:thogs med bdud rnams zhags pas 'ching mdzad ma:sgo ma phag gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo: dga' brod bdud sde sgrogs gis sdom mdzad pas:sgo ma seng gdong ma la phyag 'tshal lo:snyems byed bdud dpung dril bu'i bsgyur mdzad pas:sgo ma sbrul gdong ma la 'tshal lo rnal 'byor dkar smug sna tshogs mdangs gis 'khyud:rgyas pa'i las mdzad drug la rnal 'byor dmar ljang kha dog sna tshogs mdzad:dbang gi las mdzad drug la phyag 'chal lo:rnal 'byor ljang sngon mdzes pa'i mdangs kyis 'byud:

drag po'i las mdzad drug la phrin las bzhi yis thabs kyi sgo rnams skyongs: las rnams grub mdzad ma la bde gshegs zhi khro rig 'dzin rab 'byams la: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: dam tshig nyams chags rtog sgrib kun dag nas: 'gyur med rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob 31ga: de ltar phyag 'tshal thab ldan na nyams chagaganyes lhung kun dag cing sa ma rtogs pa'i yon tan rgyas rag 'dzan sa la the mi tshom sa ma yu rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag lha mgon po' bsrungs nga sprul thugs sras dpal du shog gu h+ye brda thim snyi zhes pa'ang nye gnas mkhar lo' yang yang bskur ngor sgom lo gdar gyi ri na bzhugs pa'i zhi khro'i bskyed rdzogs zab pa'i dum bu gcig dpal ldan brag lha mgon po'i gnasamadun seng brag g.yu yi ral gsang nasabaton pa brda' ras las rig 'dzan 'ja' lusardo rjes bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba mgi le/

ra rdo: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las: zhi khro ngan song dong sprug kyis rdor sems bsgom bzlas chags nyams rang grol bzhugs so:ra rdo: kun bza zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo lha badz+razla/ gnyen po stobs bzhi tshangs pa yis rdor sems sgom bzlas 'bogs pa ni rang nyid tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba nya gang ba'i khar: shāḥ dkar po 'od du zhi ba las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal 'dzum spyan dwangs rab tu dgyes pa'i nyams can: longs sku'i rgyan chas bcu gsum gyi spras shing cung zad 'gyeng ba'i rnam 'gyur dang ldan pas: phyag g.yas rig stong mtshon pa'i gser gyi rdo rje thugs ga'i stod du brten pa: g.yon pa'i snang stong dngul dkar gyi dril bu dku la brten cing: zhabs skyil krung phyed dang bcas kyi g.yas pa'i mthe bong rang gi spyi bor reg pa tsam gyis: bzhugs shing 'ja' dang 'od phung mu med pa 'khrigs pa'i thugs shar zla ba rgyas pa'i khar: yig brgya mu tig gi phreng ba ltar g.yas su ngang sga ra ra 'khor ba las

'od zer 'phros: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' dngos 'dra ba spyan drangs bstims: snye badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya dza: dza hūṃ baṃ ho:asnye pa tram̐ sogs bha pra ti dza ā :: (ཿ sangs rgyas gyi thugs 'dzin cing mi rtogs ye shes rdo rje sems sku gsum dam tshig mchog sbyin pa rigs 'dus de bzhin nyid la 'dud sngags kyiphreng ba las bdud rtsi byang chub sems gyi chu rgyun babs: rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs lus kyi nang thams cad gang 'khor ba thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes lhung dam tshig chags nyams rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes byas rgyud la ci gnas pa thams cad sang sang dag nas lus shel rgong dri ma med pa ltar ram 'od kyi rnam par dmigs bla badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya sogs yig brgya yig drug ci nus su bzlas mthar sngags kyi mchod cing bstod pa ni hūṃ mi rtog rdo rje ye shes sku: dmigs med shes rab yum dang rol: thugs rjes 'gro 'dul phrin las 'gyed: rdo rje sems la phyag 'tshal bstod bdag ni mi shes rmongs dbang gis dam tshig la ni 'gal zhing nyams: mi 'chab 'gyod dang sdom sems bcas: gtso bo

ra rdo: rdo rje sems la bshags: 'gro mgon khyod la bdag skyabs mchi: sdig sgrib nyes lhung dag par mdzod: zhes gsol ba btab tshe dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal 'dzum pa zhig mdzad nas rig kyi bu khyod kyi sdig sgrib dag pa yin no zhes lung bstan gnang bar bsam la: dadzagab 'de yi myur du bdag: thugs mchog rdor sems 'grub gyur nas: 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus par: de yi sa la 'khod par shog: bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'od du zhi nas rang la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur de smra bsam brjod bral kyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go: thab mchog rgyal po bla med 'dis dam tshag nyams chags sor chud byed rig 'dzin sa pa the mi tshom rdo rje sems dpa 'i sras su gyur sa ma rwa rgya rgya rgya bka' 'di brag la mgon po 'i srungs thugs kyi sras dang phrad gyur cig gu rgya brda zim snyizhes pa' nye gnas mkhar lo'i bskur ngor rig 'dzina'aja' lusardo rje'i dpal wan mgon po'i gnas mdun seng brag g.yu yi ral gsang nas bton pas zab chos byin rlabs tshan kha ma nyams pa'i sde tshan bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis gyur cig sarba ma le/ dge'o/

sgo kyi bye ma'i dmigs pa ni rang gi thugs ga'i 'od kyi mdun bskyed bskul: lha tshogs thugs gar zla steng sa bon mthar: rang sngags pho g.yas mo g.yon drag du 111: de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phros rang rang mdzod sbus sgo nas phyir la thon: bye ma dang ni 'od zer dbyer med par: tshe 'das la thim dug lnga'i sgrib pa dag:ba mo nyi zer phog pa lta bur bsgoms: ma ma ko ling tshe 'das kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad shirnyi ku ru ye sogs

ra〈: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las:zhi khro ngan song dong sprugs kyis:lta ba'i lhung bshags nyams chags sdig sgrib rang grol bzhugs:ra/: kun bzang zhi khro'i la la phyag 'tshal lo za/zan na lta ba'i dgong klo btsan sa zan yang na stobs bzha cha sa ba yas maḥkun bzang chos kyi sku ni mkha' ltar dag:rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams sprin phung 'khrigs:gnyis med rang ngo shes pa'i phyag 'chal lo:nyams chags sdig sgrib bshags sbyangs dag tshangs stsol:ma rig rkyen bzhi 'thas pa'i bag chags kyis:sgo gsum 'khrul snang tha snyad tsam du bshags ming tshigs gdos por blta ba'i 'khrul snang kun:'byu dang 'byung 'gyur gnyis med chen por bshags:rtsa dag rlung sbyangs thig le rab smin nas kun bza zhi khro'i dal du ye sangs rgyas:nyon mongs rang mtshan gol ba'i nyes sgrib kyis sgyu lus gdos por bzung ba mthol lo bshags:snang stong gsal stong bde stong rig stong cha ye nas gnyis med mnyams pa nyid kyi klong:kun la zhen 'dzin 'khrul pa rngams po che ris med mnyam pa nyid kyi

klong du bshags: chos dbyings byang chub sems kyi klong yangs nas: chos can ma 'dres sa ler shar ba'i rgyan: don dam nyid na chos gzugs dbyer med ngang: logs rtogs 'khrul ba spangs blangs byas pa bshags: don dam mtha' bral lta ba rtogs gyur na: dbye bsri med par bshags pa'i rgyal por rtogs: zhi ba'i bshags pa ni 33 kun tu bzang po thugs mchog rin po che: khams gsum sa ler shar ba yab lags kyang: don dam stong chen phyag rgya yum lags kyis: bdag lus snang sems drwa bas bslus gyur pa: don dam rtogs pa'i gnong zhing 'gyod bshags pas kun bzang zhi ba bzhi bcus bzod par bzhes: tshangs par rtsal nas don dam rtogs pa stsol: khro bo'i bshags pa ni hūṃ bskal pa dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar ba'i sku he ru ka dpal che mchog dbyings phyugs zhal: nyon mongs rtogs pa rang shar yab kyi dal 'khrul ba gzhi med rtsa bral yum gyi dal: mu bzhir gol ba re drogs mngon rlom byas: rang ngo shes te gnong zhing 'gyed sems kyis: dbyings rigs gnyis med mnyams pa'i klong du bshags: lta ba'i klong ༅gas ni o

ra : chos kyi dbyings nyid spros pa med pa la: mtha' brgyad phyogs gol gnyis 'dzin dri ma kun: yum gyi mkha' dbyings yang dog med pa'i klong: thabs mchog rig pa'i rdo rje mnyam pa'i zhal gzhom zhig bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med klong: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs par btsan sa zin: sbyi bshags ni 63 dus gsum bdegashegs rgyal ba sras bcas dang zhi khro rab 'byams sprin gyi phungs por dgongs: mnyams pa'i don dam mnyam par ma rtogs te: gsang ba'i sgor zhugs gsang sngags dbang zhus nas: rdo rje slob dpon bka' las 'das gyur nongs: rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig chags nyams kun: mi 'chab mi zed gnong zhing 'gyod sems bcas: bka' drin gsum ldan thugs rje can drung bshags: 'di dang phyi mas sgrib par mi 'gyur bar tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub rtsal du gsol: rdo rje dam can gyi bshags pa ni dze+ebatsun bla ma rnas kyi spyan lam du yo byad 'byor tshogs chung ba mthol lo bshags: yi dam lha tshogs rnams kyi spyan lam du: mngon rtogs spangs len bgyis pa mthol lo bshags:

mkha' 'gro sde bzhi rnams kyi spyan lam du: khas blang dam bcas nyams pa mthol lo bshags: chos skyongs srung ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: gtor ma lo zlar 'khyang ba mthol lo bshags dus gsum pha ma rnams kyi spyan lam du: drin lan lan gyi ma lon mthol lo bshags: mched dang lcam dral rnams kyi spyan lam du: dam tshig brtse gdong chung ba mthol lo bshags: 'gro drug sems can rnams kyi spyan lam du: snying rje phan sems chung ba mthol lo bshags: so sor thar ba rnams kyi sdom pa dang: byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi bslabs pa dang: rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig la sogs pa: 'gal zhing nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags dus gsum byas pa'i sdig sgrib mthol bshags nas tshangs par mdzad nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: 'di yi mi 'dag gang yang med nyi ma'i mun pa bcom pa bzhin sngags kyi lta dgo sa zab mo yis chags nyams snang ba sor chud gyur sa ma shā lta ba'i rgyal po klong bshags 'das nā rag gnas kyang dong sprugs te rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i zhing du 'gyur rdo rje sems dpa'i sras su bsngags sa ma shā bka' 'di brag lha mgon po'i srung skal bzang pa da tshal

ra /: bzhad gyur cig gu rgya brda thim snyizhes pa 'di'ang nye gnas mkhar lo' chags pa 'a me long ngor rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje' gas ba ngom nas bde sto gzung 'dzin 'jug tu rol ba'i zlos gar bsgyur ba'i phrin sbyor me cas bka' drin las so sarba ma le/

dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khrul gzhi stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: zhes phyi bskang 'bul sa ātshwa skyemed dza sa ()dbyings kyis bhan+ta na 'gags med 'od gsal snang ba'i bdud rtsi'i bskang: gang shar 'od gsal lha mo'i rgyan dang bcas: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: spros bral a wa dhu ta'i bhasto phu ye shes bde ba zag med bdud rtsi'i bskang: blo yid las 'das lha mo'i rgyan dang bcas: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang phyir 'bul: chos dbyings mishig thig le'i bhan+ta rtsa sgrib bral 'od lnga gsal ba'i bdud rtsi'i bskang rig pa rang byung lha ma'i rgyan dang bcas: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskangs phyir 'bul:rnal 'byor chags nyams skong gyur cig: rtogs sgrig 'khrul ba byang gyur cig: las dang bag chags dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khrul gzhi stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig: zhes bdud rtsa sman gya bskang ba bya oṃ āḥ( spyo bo bde chen 'khor lo'i bhan+ta phu sdug bsngal rnam par grol ba'i rak+ta'i bkang: bde chen 'bar ba'i bskul te chags

brgyad ma spangs gnas dag sems dpa' brgyad: yul brgyad rang sar grol ba'i sems ma brgyad: rtag chad mu bzhi rang grol sgo skyongs bzhi: tshad med rang gzugs ye shes sgo ma yum nyon drug rnam dag bcom ldan thub pa drug: rmad byung tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskang: rnal 'byor chags sogs cig: 'khrul ba gzhir sangs che mchog he ru ga: kun gzhi dbyings sgrol kri ti ma bzhi yum: che mchog yab yum rig bzhi thabs shes brgyad yul la spyod pa'i phra min chen mo dang: dkyil 'khor sgo skyongs ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: rnal 'byor grogs mchog dbang phyug nyi shu brgyad ko'u seng bcu drug sgo skyongs dbang phyug rnams rmad byung rnal 'byor cug snang srid thal 'byin phur pas rgyas 'debs pas: thabs mchog srid pa rdo rje gzhon nu dang: stong nyid mnyam sbyor 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum nyon mongs mtshan ma rang grol ki la ya: mi dge bcu spangs ye shes khro bo bcu: dge bcu don rtogs shes rab khro mo yum: rlung sems dbu mar rol ba'i za byed bcu: bdag rtog mtshan 'dzin gcod pa'i gsod byed yum

ra : mtha' bzhi gdon 'dul ye shes sgo ma bzhi: rten 'brel gnas stong phur srung bcu gnyis dang: rnal 'byor zhabs pad khur ba'i skyes ging bzhe rdo rje phur ba'i la tshogs 'khor bcas rnams rmad byung tshogs kyi mchod pas thugs dam bskangs: thugs dam bskang b.lidam rdzas ni: mchog chen mchog bran mtshan ldan dang: za le 'bru dang shel rgong lug: tsa ra mkha' ldeng gser mig dang rdo rje zil ba byang chub sems: pad+ma rak+ta shes rab mtshal mtshan 'dzin rnam dag phyi mchod sprin: nyon mongs rang grol 'dod yon lnga: rtogs pa cer grol rig ma bcu: khams gsum gnas stong sman gtor raka: myong grol dga' ston tshogs chen po: bdud rtsi bam gyi mchod pa yis zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskangs dgyes shing tshogs rdzogs mthu byin gyis: rnal 'byor chags nyams skong gyur cig: rtogs sgrib 'khrul ba byang gyur cig: las dang bag chags dag gyur cig: khams gsum 'khrul gzhi stong gyur cig: 'bras bu sku gsum thob gyur cig zhes zhi khra'i mdangs bskang bya'o (ཿ dngos po chos nyid yang par bskang:

snang ba ye shes rjen par bskangs: gsal ba shes rab 'bar ba'i bskangs: sdug bsngal bde ba chen por bskang: gnyis 'dzin spros dang bral bar bskangs: 'khor ba ka nas dag par bskangs kun rdzob don dam bden par bskangs: (ཿ bskang ba med de khams gsum yongs dag bskongs: sbyor ba med de khams gsum yongs mnyam sbyor:sgrol ba med de khams gsum ka dag sgrol ye bskang ye sbyor ye sgrol chen por bskangs zhes don dam mtha' bral gyi bskang ba bya a la la ho: bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la: 'dir tshogs 'dus pa rnams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa'i mthu la brten nas: nyam chags rtog sgrib rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nyes lhung ci mchis pa thams cad mi gnas par sang sang kun bzang yang pa chen po'i klong du bskang shing sor chud de: tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mchog thun mongs gi dngos grub dus da lta nyid la thob par gyur cig: e ma ho e o e: zhes smon lam drag tu btab so de ltar bskang ba'i tshogs chen rdzogs sgrib pa mtha' dag dang bral te

ra /: na rag 'khor ba dong sprug nas rig 'dzin sa la the mi tshom sa ma mā rgya rgya rgya zab mo gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i brda' 'od gsal dgo sa pa'i rang bsrel 'di dpal ldan brag lha mgon po' bsrungs bka' log lag tu mi 'chor bar thugs sras rag 'dzan dpal du shog gu rgya brda tham snyizhes pa'ang nye gnas mkhar lo' yang yang bskur ngor 7 kho bo klong chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor b.rag 'aram̐n 'anga' lusardo rje'i rgya rong brag lha mgon po' gnas mdun seng brag g.yu yi ral gsang nas bton pa'i brda ris las dag par bsgyur ba dge zhing bkra shis par gyur cig sarba ma la/

ra rdo: zab chos 'od gsal snying thig las zhi khro ngan song dongs sprugs kyis las bum sgrub pa dri ma rang grol bzhugs so:ra rdo : kun bzang zhi khro'i ma la phyag 'tshal lo masacesanyache5 las bum dra bzang chu yis bkang rnam lnga legs sbyod legs bkram de 37 swā bha wa sogs rnya: stong palingang las las kyi bum pa mtshan nyid phun sum 'tshogs pa'i gzhal yas khang chu dang bcud thams cad kyis yongs su gtam pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la3Xlas dpal ldan bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: zhi 'dzum tshul dgu'i lang tshos 'khyud cing mtshan da dpe byad 'bar ba longs sku'i rgyan cha bcu gsum spras shing 'ja' lus sgyu ma'i sku can zhabs rdo rje'i dkyil krung gis bzhugs pa: phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje thugs gar brten cing g.yon de'i yu ba byas pas dril bu dkur brten mdzad pa: thugs sgog hūṃ ༷las 'od zer 'phros te shar phyogs mngon dga' ba'i zhings khams nas ye shes sems dpa' spran drangs la bstim mo: ྅ rang bzhin rnam dag

nas: zhi khro rab 'byams lha tshogs spyan drangs bstim: dam ye ro gcig mnyam pa nyid du bzhugs: chos nyid lta ba 'jal ba'i phyag bgyi'o: ma spangs rang grol phyi nang gsang mchod 'bul: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las gter la bstod rnal 'byor chags nyams rtogs sgrib sbyangs bya'i phyir: 'bru mchog til dang mar khu'i mchod pa 'bul:dgyes par bzhes nas las nyon dag sang nas: nyams rtogs yar ngos zla ltar 'phel gyur cig sku bho dhi cit+ta ma ha su kha dz+nyā na dhartu a: sa ru lu ru lu hūṃ bh+yo hūṃ nyams chags rtog sgrib thams cad shirnye ku ru ye swā snya brgya stong khri 4ma ci rig 'byul 'dod gsol gdab pa ni ho bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor du: bdud rtsi bsregs blug kyi mchod pa rgya chen po phul ba'i mthus rnal 'byor ba bdag gi dam tshigs chags nyams 'gal 'khrul nyes lhung dkor gyi sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag nas sa lam nyams rtogs yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i phrin las dam pa mdzad du gsol: rjes su sngags mja 'thul la bstod pa na hūṃ hrī: chos sku mkha' ltar dri med

ra rdo: dag pa las: gzugs sku 'gags med 'od dang zer bzhin brdal: sprul sku gzhan phan phrin las 'ja' ltar 'khyugs kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: dngos grub ni hūṃ hrī: mi gnas mi dmigs chos dbyings dag pa la ji lta ji snyed mkhyen gzigs dngos grub stsol: sarba sirnyi pha la trīḥ gags pa ni ho gang yang bdag blo ma rig gti mug pas: sor byang sngags kyi sdom dam nyams pa bshags: sa ma ya ā: bzod gsol ni ho 'da' nyams sems kyi dri ma ka dag nas: bshags bya bshags byed gnyis med rtogs pa 'char a ā: bsngo smon ni na mo: 'khor gsum yongs dag rab dkar dge ba 'dis: 'khrul snang 'khor ba ka nas dag gyur cig: grol gzhi'i rig pa sku gsum mngon gyur nas: kun tu bzang po'i dgongs klong byang chub shog: bsdu rim ni 63 lha tshogs rim bsdus gnyug ma'i ga'ur bsre: rjes thob snang stong zung 'jug spyod lam khyer: a phaṭa: shes brjod ni o stong zhing bdag med chos sku'i bkra shis shog gsal la 'dzin med longs sku'i bkra shis shog: thugs rje rgyud smin

sprul sku'i bkra shis sgo ga: 'khor 'das gnyis med rtogs pa'i bkra shis regag: de ltar zhi ba'i bsregs blug 'dis rnal 'byor chags nyams rtogasasgrib dag tshe bsod nyam rtogasagong 'phel rgyas mos bzhi dbang 'dus log rtog 'dul don gnyis lhun grub the tshom med sa ma mā bka' 'di brag lha mgon po'i bsru sa thugs sras rig 'dzin dpal du shog sa ma shā rgya rgya rgya zhes pa seng brag g.yu ya ral gsang nasabaton pa'i brda ris las kho bo rig 'dzin 'ja' lusardo rje'i bsgyur ba'i yig ge pa ni mi tris brgyas pa dge legs 'phel nye gnas mkhar lo' bzhed don 'grub gyur cig sabo masgo lo

༄༅// o āḥshāḥ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor na rdo rje slob dpon mched dang lcam dral rnams: nam zhig 'phos tshe rig drug mi skye zhing: ting 'dzin rtse gcig sa bcur rim bsgrod shog: nyon mongs dbang gi rig drug skye srid pa'i: gsal ba'i sgron me thugs rje der ma chung snang ba'i go 'byed zhun mar mdangs ldan 'di'i:rig 'dzin bsgrub pa po yi shul mtshon cig sa bcur khyad par rim gyi bsgrod pa'i tshe: nyon mongs bag chags ma lus der byang nas 'gro don thog pa med pa'i brtson 'grus gyis: sa bcu cig char rdzogs par gyur nas ni: sems dpa' sems ma khro bo khro mo yis sngun bsu mtha' skyongs rgyab rten sa bcu'i rtser: phyir mi ldog pa'i dngos grub der thob bo: kun tu 'od dang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa: pad+ma can dang 'khor lo tshogs chen sa bkod pa rab rdzogs de wa ko sha'i sa: thar pa chen po rdo rje mang 'dzin sa lcang lo can dang rdzogs pa bla med sa: srid gsum ngang rdzogs bya rtsol sar phyin tshe: chos sku skye ba med pa'i don rtogs nas: sna tshogs longs sku'i thabs mkhas thugs rje yi
ma 'gags sprul sku'i 'a11 don byed bar 31ga rdzogs chen pad+ma rig 'dzin gi mdzad pa'o de ltar mar me phur ba'i bsod nam sogs tshe 'das thog grangs sogs

ra rdo gakhro ngan song dongs sprug kyis: bdag 'jug sgo gsum smin grol ni zamaste/rnga she bdag mdun bum bzlas pongs rdzogs gtong tshogs bsags bskang gsol grub nas slar rten la lha khrus gsol ba ni yo byad phun sum tshogs ldan pas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu rgyun sbreng ba'i mod la 'phags pa'i sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa sbyang bar dmigs la: khrus kyi khang pa ji ltar bltams pa 37 sarba ta tha ga ta ye 〉: chos sku ka dag nam mkha' lta bu la: gzugs sku 'od zer sna tshogs sprin dpungs 'khrigs: gang 'dul 'brin las 'gro don char rgyun 'bebs: zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs la sku khrus gsol: o sarba ta dran palibadechen mchog rtsol rigs kyi bdag: nus mthu'i srid zhu'i 'jigs 'phrog lhag pa'i lha: reg pa'i sgyu lus smin mdzad rnal 'byor ma: rtsa gsum rgya mtsho'i sprin la sku oṃ sarba rgyal bamibaka' rtags spyi bor gtsug na spa: legs nyes stong sgog phyag gi mthil du gnas: phrin las chos char skal ldan bu la stsol: bka' srung gter bdag rnams la snyed sarba ta tha bdobar gshegs pa'i sku gsungs
